tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /yang dag me dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga blo dman dga' ba skyed byed bzhugs so// na mo buddhā ya mañdzu badzra ya/ /dpal yang dag par sbyor ba zla gam dgu pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga blo dman dga' ba skyed byed ces bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dbyangs ngo bo rab mdzes sprul pa'i sku/ /kun dga'i legs bshad zab don sgrog pa'i gsung / /bsod nams 'gyur med bde ba chen po'i thugs/ /grags pas sa gsum khyab pa'i yon tan can/ /rgyal mtshan rtser mchod nor bu ltar mtshungs pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i 'phrin las chu bo'i rgyun/ /bzang po'i dbang bzhis gdul bya smin mdzad la/ /lhag par mos pas rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /char sprin ltar gnag rab brjid khro bo'i sku/ /gad rgyangs drag pos gdug pa 'dul mdzad gsung / /chos dbyings mi 'gyur gsal stong zung 'jug thugs/ /yon tan rnam bzhis phrin las mdzad la 'dud/ /rdo rje theg pa'i rim gnyis lam gyi gzhi/ /smin byed dbang gi cho ga'i rim pa ni/ /rje btsun dam pa'i gsung rtsom thor bu rnams/ /bdag gis dad pa'i sgo nas lhan cig bsgrigs/ /de la 'dir yang dag me dgu'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho gas slob ma smin par byed pa la/ don gsum ste/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum mo/ /dang po la bzhi/ sa'i lha mo sta gon/ lha sta gon/ bum pa sta gon/ slob ma sta gon no/ /dang po ni sa phyogs dben zhing yid du 'ong bar phyags dar la sogs pa byas la/ bla bre dang yol ba la sogs pas dgram/ bris sku'am lugs ma la sogs pa'i yi dam chos skyong gi rten rnams ji ltar bde bar bzhugs su gsol ba'i mdun du/ de dag gi gtor ma/ sman raka dang mchod pa/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga sogs phyag len bzhin dang / gang du dkyil 'khor dgram pa'i gzhi ras la sogs pa gtsang ma'i steng du maṇḍal ji ltar rigs pa'i dbus su sa'i lha mo'i tshom bu bkod pa'i mthar/

byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog dang / chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga 'khor mar bsham/ de dag gi nang du spos/ mar me/ lha bshos rnams sgos mchod lha grangs dang mnyam pa ste/ de yang shar nub tu nyis sbrag gzhan phyogs rnams su re re ste bcu tshan/ byang shar gyi mchod pa'i nang du/ sa lha'i gtor ma gcig de'i mdun du sgos mchod gsum gong bzhin dang / slob dpon gyi mdun du stegs gang 'os la/ rdo rje dril bu/ nang mchod/ bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gnyis la mgul chings kha rgyan/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i steng du/ dung chos dri bzang gi chu blugs pa/ de'i steng du rdo rje gzungs thag yang bzhag bum pa gnyis su bum rdzas rnams kyang btab/ rnga rol cha lang dung sogs dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad ma tshang ba med par 'dus byas la/ gzhan yang / slob ma sta gon gyi phyir/ ting la sogs pa'i nang du dri bzang po btab pa'i chu/ me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa lnga tshar gcig dang / so shing / srung skud/ ku sha che chung gnyis rnams slob ma du yod kyi grangs dang mnyam pa/ dus chos su khyor chu rnams phyag len bzhin bsham mo/ /logs shig tu maṇḍal dri bzang gi chus byugs pa'i steng du lha grangs dang mthun pa'i tshom bu dgu/ gtso bo'i mdun du phul la gcig ste bcu bkod pa'ang bzhag de nas dpon slob rnams gral la 'khod pa'i mdun du gtor ma gcig chus sbyangs/ mchod g.yog pas phyag gsum btsal nas/ dkyil 'khor chen po sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma bsang sbyangs byin rlabs mdzad de 'bul bar zhu/ zhes dang / slob dpon gyis rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor nas/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mri ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐/ tshindha tshindha hūm̐ phaṭa/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ ratna bhañdza oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur zhes byin gyis rlabs/

'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wa ra ā karṣa ya dzaḥ spyan drangs/ bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ a dya nudapanna twata/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis phul nas/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ sa phyogs 'di na gnas pa yi/ /sa bdag lha klu 'khor dang bcas/ /gtor ma dam pa 'di bzhes la/ /bdag gi sgrub pa ma thon bar/ /khyed la gnas 'di bdag g.yar gyi/ /ci bde bar ni gzhan du song / /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par bya ba'i phyir du/ sa'i phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa dang / bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang / slob ma yod na/ slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar tu bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / dngos grub sgrub pa'i stong grogs mdzod/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po de dag 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig sarba bighnān gatstsha/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing dril bu drag tu dkrol/ gtor ma phyir dor/ yang mchod g.yog pas phyag gsum btsal nas/ gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad la byin rlabs gnang ba zhu/ zhes dang / slob dpon gyis kyang mchod pa rnams la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor te/ gong bzhin a mṛ tas bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bhrūṃ las thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ ā las bandha 'bar ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar hūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod yon/

zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo dang 'phan gdugs la sogs pa mchod rdzas bsam gyi mi khyab pa/ dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu zhig bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ badzra ā hā ra li āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe ūḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dhū pe ā hūm̐/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra nai wi dya āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra shapta ā hūm̐/ oṃ badzra u da pha la ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra bispu ra ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ rnga byin dbab rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar la/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa bsdu pa'i bar byas la/ de nas rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas sogs nas/ de gtso bo yab yum la thim zhes pa'i bar gyi dkyil 'khor rang la bsdus nas/ sngar gyi maṇḍal gyi tshom bu la dmigs te pa padma maṇḍa la zhes brjod pas/ padma'i gdan du gyur/ bdag gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes dang / rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang gyur gshegs/ /zhes lan gsum brjod cing / thal mo g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa lan gsum sa la reg ngag tu/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'thon te/ padma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ sku mdog ser mo rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag na rin po che'i bum pa bsnams pa/ rnal 'byor bka' stsal ji ltar bgyi zhes smra bar gyur/ oṃ badzra ā hā ra li hūm̐ nas/ badzra bispu ra ye hūm̐ gi bar dang / gtor ma chus sbyangs la/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ pṛ thi wi de wī sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul la/

rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ shākya seṅge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gi bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar bya phyir dkyil 'khor bri/ /de phyir dpang gyur lha mos kyang / /sa gzhi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /lan gsum/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi nas/ slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ /zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ de nas sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod pas/ lha mo dgyes pa'i mdangs byung ste/ khyod ni slob dpon dam pa yin/ /sems can don phyir dkyil 'khor bris/ /zhes gnang ba byin par mos nas/ se gol dang bcas pas/ oṃ pṛ thi wi de wī badzra muḥ lha mo sa de nyid du thim pas/ gser gyi sa gzhir gyur/ zhes brjod la/ sa lha'i maṇḍal dang / mchod gtor rnams bsal lo/ /gnyis pa lha sta gon ni/ lha grangs dang mthun pa'i tshom bu bkod pa'i maṇḍal de dbus su bzhag la maṇḍal de la dmigs nas/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tās sbyangs/ oṃ dharma dhā tu sogs nas/ gdan bskyed pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar byas la/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du dbus su hūm̐ phyogs mtshams brgyad du gaṃ tsaṃ praṃ baṃ paṃ ghaṃ shaṃ tsaṃ/ sa bon rnams las 'od 'phros 'dus don gnyis byas/ yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su dpal chen khro bo'i rgyal/ /zhes pa nas/ ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /zhes pa'i ma dang / yum chen khro mo dbang phyug sngo/ /nas/ yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud pas bzhugs/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi gtso bo yab yum bskyed/ shar du lha mo gau rī sngo/ /zhes pa nas g.yon brkyang me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ zhes pa'i bar gyi 'khor rnams bdag bskyed ltar bskyed/ 'on kyang sa bon rnams dor la/ lha mo zhes kun la sbyar ro/ /de nas lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs khar hūm̐ sngon po/

rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas he ru ka lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ yang 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha khro bo rigs lnga badzra sa mā dzaḥ thabs kyi spyod pa sogs sngags dang bcas pas dbang bskur/ gtso 'khor thams cad la khro bo rigs lnga re res dbu brgyan/ de nas mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ā las bandha 'bar ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thog pa med pa nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ oṃ badzra ā hā ra li āḥhūm̐ nas/ oṃ badzra bispu ra ye hūm̐ gi bar gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ sgeg phreng sogs kyi phyi mchod/ rang byung gdod nas dag pa yi nas khā hi ces pa'i bar gyis nang mchod/ rtogs med spros bral sogs sngags dang bcas pas de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa/ hūm̐ bde gshegs mnyam nyid sogs bstod pas bstod pa rnams bdag bskyed ltar byas nas/ lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas spos bzung / g.yon dril bu gsil shing / ngag tu/ hūm̐ he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /rig pa'i rgyal po phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dkyil 'khor thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /mgon po bdag ni bri bar 'tshal/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa lags/ /de bas bka' drin mdzad par 'os/ /'gro ba 'khor lo'i don mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /'bras nas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /sngags kyi lha gzhan gang lags dang / /'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang / /gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang / /sems can bstan la dga' ba dang / /gang su rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag cag gi ……bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yi/ /he ru ka yi dkyil 'khor 'di/

/yo byad ci 'byor pa dag gi /'gro ba dag phyir bdag 'bri bas/ /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /thugs rjes thugs dpag mdzad nas su/ /dkyil 'khor par bcas thams cad kyis/ /thugs rjes dgongs nas gnang bar mdzod/ /ces lan gsum brjod/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi sogs nas/ las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol zhes pa'i bar sa lha bzhin brjod pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dgyes nas/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod gzhan don rgya che bar gyis shig ces brjod cing lhas gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ /gsum pa bum pa sta gon ni/ bum pa rnams 'khyil pas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang / ā las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi steng du bhrūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa gnyis yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyi yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma/ zla ba/ drag po pho mo'i gdan/ 'dab ma brgyad la nyi ma dang ro'i gdan re re/ las kyi bum par padma nyi ma'i gdan/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du dbus su hūm̐/ phyog mtshams brgyad du gaṃ tsaṃ praṃ baṃ paṃ ghaṃ shaṃ tsaṃ/ las kyi bum par/ hūm̐ ljang sngon rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su dpal chen khro bo'i rgyal nas ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ zhes pa'i bar dang / de'i pang na/ yum chen khro mo dbang phyug sngo nas/ yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud pas bzhugs kyi bar dang / shar du lha mo nas g.yon brkyang me dpung dbus na bzhugs zhes pa'i bar rnams lha sta gon bzhin dang / las kyi bum par/ 'khyil pa dkar dmar dbus ljang zhal/ /rtsa phyag rdo rje thod khrag dang / /bar pas rgya gram be con bsnams/ /tha mas phur sgril yum la 'khyud/

/lha mo rdo rje sgra mdzad ljang / /zhal gcig phyag g.yas dril bu bsnam/ /g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stob/ /brkyang bskum gar gyi gnyis med sbyor/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs khar hūm̐ sngon po zhes pas gnas gsum byin brlab/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas he ru ka lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas ye shes pa bcug thabs kyi spyod pa sogs kyis dbang bskur te/ rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs dang / sgeg phreng sogs kyi phyi mchod nang mchod rnams lha sta gon bzhin byas la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ bde gshegs mnyam nyid nas/ lha mo rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa'i bar dang / 'khor ba'i nyon mongs dug dang 'dra ba la/ /ye shes bdud rtsi sman gyi rtsi gtong zhing / /thugs rjes kun la khyab pa'i dbyings su 'khyil/ /khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces bstod la/ pad skor gyi gzungs thag blang nas/ rang gi snying kha nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten te song bas/ lha rnams kyi rgyud bskul/ sku lus las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ bum pa gang bar gyur zhes brjod cing bsam la/ ru lu dang / kro dhi shwa ri sogs lha dgu'i sngags ci rigs pa dang / oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta sogs 'khyil pa'i sngags ji ltar rigs pa bzlas te gong bzhin mchod bstod byas nas/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang / ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyi lhag chad kha bskang la/ de nas dung chos kyi chu bum nang du blug cing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum nang gi lha rnams rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu nas/ bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can du gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam la/ de nas bsrung ma'i gtor ma 'bul dgos rnams 'dir phul la/

bzhi pa slob ma sta gon ni/ slob ma gcig nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar zung du ma gyur pa'i slob ma rnams khrus byas gral du 'khod pa la/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkram bsdu tshar ba dang / slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dbang bskur ba zab mo gsan snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la 'dir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis sems can so so'i bsam pa dang mthun par/ chos kyi tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs pa thams cad kyang / rigs su bsdu na/ rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang / 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa gnyis su 'dus shing / de yang pha rol tu phyin pa las gsang sngags kyi theg pa khyad chos rnam pa bzhis khyad par du 'phags par tshul gsum sgron ma las gsung la/ slob dpon ye shes snying pos khyad chos bdun gyis zab par bshad pa'i sngags kyi theg pa la gsang sngags rnying ma dang / gsar mar grags pa gnyis ni/ gtso bor 'gyur snga phyi'i sgo nas bzhag cing / zhib tu phye na cho ga'i rnam gzhag dang / lha'i bskyed chog sogs mi 'dra ba'i khyad par du ma snang na yang / deng sang rnying ma'i rgyud gzhung gi bshad pa dang / rnam par dag pa'i cho ga'i lag len phal cher nub nas/ dbang bskur ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i rnam gzhag kyang med par/ bsnyen sgrub sbrags pa'i phrin gzhung re tsam gyis/ lha 'dre dang skye bo chos kyi tha snyad mi shes pa rnams kyi mgo bo skor ba ma gtogs/ rtog dpyod dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis dpyad par bya ba mang du gda'/ de nas gsang sngags gsar rnying gang ltar na yang / rgyud sde'i dbye ba bzhir bshad pa/ lngar bshad pa/ drug tu bshad pa/ bdun du bshad pa sogs rab tu mang na'ang / rnying ma'i skabs 'dir kṛ ya/ u pa/

yo ga ste bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum la phyi'i rgyud sde dang / ma hā yo ga a nu yo ga a ti yo ga ste rnal 'byor chen po dang / rjes su rnal 'byor dang / shin tu rnal 'byor gsum la thabs dang / shes rab dang / gnyis su med pa'i rgyud du grags pa la nang gi rgyud sde zhes tha snyad 'dogs la/ pha rgyud la mdo'i skor dang / ma rgyud la sgyu 'phrul dang / gnyis med rgyud la sems phyogs zhes kyang grags/ lung a nu yo ga shes rab kyi rgyud la/ tant+ra chen po sde bco brgyad du grags kyang rgyud rnam par dag pa ni/ zla gsang thig le sku yi rgyud/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gsung gi rgyud/ gsang ba 'dus pa thugs kyi rgyud/ bdud rtsi che mchog yon tan gyi rgyud/ karma mā la phrin las kyi rgyud lnga las/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi rgyud 'dir/ rigs lnga phyogs gcig tu sgrub pa rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor zla gam lnga bcu rtsa brgyad pa dang / rigs so sor sgrub pa la rigs drug gi dkyil 'khor 'byung yang / da lta yongs su grags pa mi bskyod pa'i rigs gtso bor gyur pa/ yang dag zla gam dgu pa dang / de las kyang bskyed pa'i rim pa cha dbri nas rdzogs pa chen po'i man ngag nyams su len pa'i phyir yang dag mar me gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams gsungs pa las/ da lan dpal he ru ka lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba sgrub par byed pa lags/ 'di la slob dpon chen po hūm̐ ka ras mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang / dkyil chog mnyam sbyor gyi rgyud kyi 'grel pa rnams bod du 'gyur zhing / brgyud pa'i bka' babs kyang so zur snubs gsum la sogs pa mang du byung na yang / slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyi dngos slob 'khon klu'i dbang po dang / 'khon rdo rje rin chen gnyis nas brgyud de 'khon rog shes rab tshul khrims yan la yang dag dang phur pa la thugs dam gyi mthil mdzad/

de nas 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po dang / rje btsun sa skya pa chen po nas rim pas brgyud pa'i yang dag sa lugs zhes grags pa la/ bla ma sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i yang dag dang phur pa phyogs gcig pa'i sgom khog dang / rje btsun grags pas mdzad pa'i phur pa'i sgrub thabs kyi tho yig gan pa rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor rigs bsdus kyi dkyil chog gi lhan thabs dang / yang dag me dgu dang / me gcig gi sgrub thabs rnams skabs 'di'i rten so'i gzhung yin kyang / rgya bod kyi bstan bcos de dag ches gsal bar mi bzhugs pas/ bla ma rnams kyi gsung bgros phyag bzhes kyis legs par brgyan nas sgrub par byed pa la/ sta gon dang / dngos gzhi gnyis/ sta gon la bzhi las/ dang po sa'i lha mo sta gon/ lha sta gon/ bum pa sta gon rnams slob dpon kho nas bsgrubs pas chog pas sngon du song nas/ da slob ma sta gon la don bcu bzhi'i dang po/ lus kyi bya ba khrus byas gos gsar pa gyon snyim pa me tog dang bcas nas gral la 'dug pa tsam gyi khyab cing / gnyis pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan po bskyed du gzhug pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang / /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni gzhug par bya/ /bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan/ /gzhan dag 'jig rten pha rol gnyer/ /dad pa chen po ldan pa dag /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor gzhug bya ste/ /'di yi 'bras bu gnyer mi bya/ /gal te 'di 'bras don gnyer na/ /'jig rten pha rol 'grub mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na/ /'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub/ /ces brjod la/ de'i don ni 'di yin te/ sngags kyi dngos grub ces bya ba sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub don du gnyer ba rnams dkyil 'khor chen po 'di nyid du 'jug par bya ba yin gyi/

des na 'jig rten 'di'i don bsod nams thob pa dang / tshe 'dir nad zhi/ gdon zhi/ skye ba phyi ma lha mi'i go 'phang thob pa don du gnyer ba na/ dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir gzhug pa'i skal ba yang med/ gzhug kyang mi dgos te/ de rnams ni thabs gzhan gyi sgo nas bsgrub tu yod/ des na 'jig rten pha rol la dmigs pa'i 'bras bu ste/ gzhan don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa don du gnyer ba yin na/ tshe 'di'i nad zhi/ gdon zhi/ phyi ma lha mi'i go 'phangs tsam du zad/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi rnam par grol ba yang 'bad med 'grub par 'gyur ba yin te/ dper na 'bras mkhar ma lo legs na/ rtswa dang phub ma la sogs pa zhar la 'byung ba dang 'dra bas/ khyed rang rnams bsam pa 'di bzhin bskyed mdzod/ khams gsum 'khor ba gang du gnas kyang / sdug bsngal dang skyon gyi rang bzhin las ma 'das/ de yang rang nyid rkyang pa 'khor ba las thar bas mi chog sems can 'di dag thams cad skye ba snga ma rnams nas rang la phan btags pa'i pha ma drin can sha stag yin pas 'di thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bsgral te bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god par bya/ de'i phyir du dkyil 'khor chen po 'di lta bur zhugs la dbang blang zhing lam nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa dung pa re dran par mdzod/ de mya ngan las 'da' ba'i bsam pa brtan po bskyed du gzhug pa yin/ gsum pa nang gi dbang bskur ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon la he ru ka dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud drag po byas pas/ slob dpon gyi snying kha nas 'od 'phros khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas sdig pa dang sgrib pa sbyangs/ lus 'od kyi gong bu gcig tu gyur pa de nyid slob dpon gyi hūm̐ zhes brjod pas zhal du drangs/ thugs khar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu/

sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkha' nang du bab pa las/ skad cig gi khyed rang rnams he ru ka sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i sku can re rer gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon he ru ka yab yum mnyam par sbyar ba'i dga' ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' spyan drangs/ slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs khar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas mkha' nang du khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim pas/ dbang bskur ba dang ye shes pa 'dres pa ro gcig tu gyur par mos pa mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ yang slob dpon gyis hūm̐ zhes brjod pas khyed rang rnams phyir 'thon so so'i gral la 'khod par mos pa mdzod/ bzhi pa khyad par can gyi don zhu ba'i phyir/ bla ma dang he ru ka gnyis su med pa la slob ma sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i ched du maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgos su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum bdag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ lnga pa gsang sngags la spro ba bskyed pa ni/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yis/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin gang yang ma byon dang / /da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa kun/ /de dag kun gyi gsang sngags kyi/

/cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen te/ /dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med de/ /shākya seṅge skyob pa yis/ /drag po chen po bdud kyi sde/ /stobs chen dag kyang des bcom ste/ /'jig rten mthun par gshegs nas ni/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces brjod la/ de'i don ni 'di yin te/ khyed rnams la bu zhes nye ba'i tshig gi bos nas/ khyed rnams ni tshul chen po ste/ de la pha rol tu phyin pa dang / sngags kyi theg pa gnyis las/ sngags kyi theg pa'i snod du rung ba yin te/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas gsang sngags kyi thabs la brten nas myur du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa yin pa'i phyir/ des na lam 'di yang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam yin pas/ lam 'dir 'jug pa ni skal ba bzang bas/ blo 'di las gzhan du ma 'gyur bar dga' ba rgya chen po bsgom par gyis shig de ltar spro ba bskyed nas/ drug pa sdom pa bzung ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar dpal he ru ka lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba'i spyan sngar thun mong gi sdom pa rnams bzung bar khas blang snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /rnal 'byor sngags bdag he ru ka /'khor lo bzhugs pa'i bdag nyid can/ /de rnams la yang skyabs su mchi/ /dkyil 'khor bdag por gyur pa yi/ /byang chub sems kyi dngos po ni/ /khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dkyil dang 'khor du bcas pa rnams/ /gtso bo 'khor dang bcas pa yi/

/rnal 'byor 'khor bcas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad ni/ /de dag bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung ste/ /ji srid byang chub ma thob bar/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung / /bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa kun/ /bde gshegs spyan sngar mchis nas su/ /dus gsum sdig pa bgyis pa rnams/ /khyed la ma lus so sor bshags/ /sangs rgyas chos dang byang chub sems/ /rang rgyal dgra bcom nyan thos sogs/ /'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams la/ /de la rjes su yi rang bgyi/ /sems can ma lus srid par ltung / /'gro rnams kun la phan bya'i phyir/ /bdag gi dus 'di nyid du ni/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /de ltar thun mong gi sdom pa bzung nas/ thun mong ma yin pa rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gi bsdus pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams kyang bzung bar bgyi'o snyam pas/ 'di'i rjes zlos kyang lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ bde gshegs rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /rdo rje rigs mchog sdom pa ni/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog sdom pa ni/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin ni dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /padma'i rigs mchog sdom pa ni/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /de bzhin brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bsgrubs nas kyang /

/sems can 'khor bar bying ba rnams/ /byang chub gnas su bsgral bar gyi/ /de ltar dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams bzung nas/ bdun pa byin gyis brlab pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams he ru kar gsal ba'i spyi gtsug tu badzra he ru ka sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du buddha he ru ka dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu༞ rkang pa g.yas pa'i mthil du ratna he ru ka ser po rin po che dang dril bu༞ rkang pa g.yon pa'i mthil du padma he ru ka dmar po padma dang dril bu༞ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du karma he ru ka ljang gu ral gri dang dril bu༞ dpral bar sku'i dbang phyug dkar po rtse gsum dang thod pa༞ mgrin par gsung gi rgyal po dmar po dbyug pa dang zhags pa༞ snying khar khyab 'jug nag po 'khor lo dang thod pa 'dzin pa rnams gnas de dag tu 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de rnams las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad de dag gi rnam par spyan drangs nas/ so so la thim pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas slob dpon gyi dri'i chu rdo rje dang bcas pas khyed rang rnams kyi dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying kha rnams su yas mar reg pa la brten nas sku gsung thugs kyi lha tshogs gsal btab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes dang dri'i thig le bya/ yang / hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ zhes brjod cing mas yar reg slar yas mar reg la oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas slar sku gsung thugs kyi lha tshogs gsal btab cing brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ brgyad pa mchod pa ni/ khyed rnams lhar bskyed cing byin gyis brlabs pa de nyid mchod pa'i yul du bzang ba yin pas thog mar me tog dbu la phul ba'i mos pa mdzod/

oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang slob ma re re'i mgor 'bras la sogs pa'i 'bru gtor/ de bzhin du bdug spos shangs la/ mar me spyan lam du/ dri'i chu thugs khar/ sosti ka la sogs pa'i zhal zas ljags la phul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ zhes so so'i sngags brjod cing rdzas rnams dbul lo/ /de ltar mchod pa rnams kyi rgyas par mchod nas/ dgu pa dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i phyir so shing sbyin pa ni/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta dang las bum gyi chus bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las so shing sor bcu gnyis pa rtse mo me tog gis brgyan pa rdo rje'i slob ma rnams kyi dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ ru lu dang / oṃ badzra dzi hwa saṃ warda ni swāhā/ sngags gnyis lan gsum re bzlas rjes/ zhes mngon par bsngags pa'i so shing de nyid khyed rang rnams kyi phyag thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du sbyin par mos pa mdzod/ ces dang sngags rjes mas slob ma rnams la sbyin tshar ba dang / so shing de nyid rgyu rin po che gser ram dngul las grub par mos la/ de'i rtse mo sos nem gyi drud pa la brten nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi tshe 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sman pa mkhas pas skyugs sman btang ba bzhin du skyugs par mos la gral gyi rim pa bzhin bzhengs te/ slon dpon la zhal phyogs pa'i tshul gyi tshom bu dbus ma 'di'i steng du/ oṃ badzra hā sa haḥzhes gsung zhing 'dor bar zhu zhes dang / dor ba dang bstun 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin phyogs mtshams sogs rtse mo gang la bstan pa bzhin rim gyis ngo sprad/ thams cad kyi dor tshar ba dang / de ltar so shing gi rtse mo de nyid rang dang bla ma la bstan na phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur la/ steng du bstan na mkha' spyod/ 'og tu bstan na sa 'og gi dngos grub/ shar du zhi ba/

lhor mngon spyod/ nub tu dbang / byang du rgyas pa/ mtshams rnams su bstan na bum pa bzang po la sogs pa'i dngos grub ci rigs pa 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes brjod/ slob dpon gyis so shing byin rlabs dang slob ma la sprod pa'i ring la/ mchod g.yog pas slob dpon 'dug pa'i mdun du dri bzang gi chus khru gru bzhi tsam byugs pa'i dbus dang phyogs mtshams su nas kyi tshom bu re bkod pa so shing dor ba'o/ /de nas bcu pa kha dag cing rmi lam gsal po 'byung pa'i phyir khyor chu sbyin dgos pas/ ru lu dang / oṃ hrīḥbi shuddhe sarba dharmaḥsarba pā paṃ ni tsā sya/ saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi kalpān a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes mngon par bsngags pa'i dri'i chu de nyid khyed rang rnams kyi khyor ba g.yas par lan gsum sbyin pa la brten nas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang / sngags rjes mas khyor ba g.yas par lan gsum du sbyin no/ /de nas bcu gcig pa srung skud sbyin pa ni/ srung skud 'khyil sngags dang las bum gyi chus bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i skud pa dmar po slob ma'i lus tshad dang mnyam pa gsum bsgril du byas pa la/ rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum btab pa/ slob dpon gyi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ sta gon gyi ……mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs kha nas ye shes kyi srad bu'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ dam tshig gi srad bu la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ ru lu brjod/ zhes mngon par bsngags pa'i skud pa de nyid skyes pa rnams kyi dpung pa g.yon dang / bud med rnams kyi g.yas la btags pa la brten nas lus ngag yid gsum gyi bar chad thams cad las bsrung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang 'ching dus ru lu dang 'khyil sngags brjod/ mdud pa btab tshar ba dang mchod g.yog pas las bum gyi chu gtor/

slob dpon gyis mdud pa'i steng du rdo rje bzhag la/ sarba buddha mai tri rakṣa ku ru swāhā/ zhes brjod/ de ltar rmi lam dang dngos grub kyi bar chad thams cad las bsrungs nas/ bcu gnyis pa rmi lam mi 'khrug cing gsal po 'byung ba'i phyir ku sha sbyin pa ni/ ku sha che chung gnyis/ las bum gyi chu dang / 'khyil sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa/ rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi rmi lam mi 'khrug cing gsal po 'byung ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dhī ha lan gsum tsam bzlas nas/ zhes mngon par bsngags pa'i ku sha chung ba de sngas kyi don du phyag g.yas dang / che ba stan gyi don du phyag g.yon du sbyin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang / ku sha g.yas su sbyin dus dhī dang / g.yon du ha zhes brjod/ bcu gsum pa zam mo'i chos bshad pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gi sems can mnyam med don/ /bla med byed pa nus pa yin/ /bskal ba bye ba du mar ni/ /sngon chad sdig pa byas pa gang / /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang gi spyod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /ngan 'gro de yi gcod par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /bdag nyid chen po kun gyi ni/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/

/yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin par/ /de phyir khyed rnams theg chen du/ /sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /khyed rnams 'dir ni dong bas na/ /rang byung skal ba chen po pa/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes brjod la/ de'i don ni 'di yin te/ 'jig rten du gang dkon na sangs rgyas 'byung ba dkon/ byon nas kyang chos gsung ba dkon/ chos kyi nang nas kyang theg pa chen po gsung ba dkon/ theg chen gyi nang nas kyang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos gsung ba shin tu dkon te/ dpe gang dang 'dra na u dum wa ra'i me tog dang 'dra ste/ de yang sangs rgyas 'jig rten du gcig 'byon pa na de dang khad nye ba'i sa phyogs zhig tu u dum wa ra'i me tog gcig 'byung / sangs rgyas de yang rgyal rigs las 'byon na dkar po/ bram ze'i rigs las 'byung na ser po 'byung la/ sangs rgyas de lhums su zhugs pa na me tog kha 'bu/ bltams pa na kha bye/ gzhon nu rol rtsed mdzad pa na rgyas/ dka' thub mdzad pa na cung zad rnying / sangs rgya ba'i tshul ston pa rgyas/ chos kyi 'khor bskor ba na shin tu rgyas/ mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul ston pa na me tog de yang bskams nas 'gro ba de dang chos mtshungs pa yin no/ /rdo rje theg pa'i chos ni sangs rgyas 'byon pa las kyang dkon te/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ 'das pa'i thub pa chen po sangs rgyas mar me mdzad nas 'od srungs kyi bar gyis kyang gsang sngags ma gsungs par bshad pa'i shugs las/ ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas byams pa nas mos pa'i bar gyis kyang mi gsung / des na da ltar gyi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po 'di nyid kho nas sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis gsungs pas shin tu dkon/ 'o na dkon pas ci phan/ ri bong gi rwa dang nam mkha'i me tog kyang dkon no snyam na de lta bu'i dkon la phan yon med pa de dang mi 'dra ste/

rdo rje theg pa'i lam 'di ni dkon la phan yon chen po dang ldan pa yin te/ dper na brag phug kha byang bltas mun pa mun nag chen po/ sngar snang ba'i khyad par 'ong ma myong ba zhig tu/ mar me chung ngu cig btegs pa na/ de ma thag mun pa de med par 'gyur ba chos nyid yin pa bzhin du khyed rang rnams kyis sang nyin dkyil 'khor gyi tshon ci tsam mthong ba'i mod la yang / bskal pa bye ba dpag tu med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad 'dag par 'gyur na dkyil 'khor chen por zhugs la/ dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par thob nas dam tshig dang sdom pa la nan tan du byas te sngags kyi lam bsgom pa la brten nas/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur bas na dga' ba rgya chen po bskyed la/ lam la 'dun pa dang brtson 'grus byed dgos so/ /de ltar zab mo'i chos bshad nas/ bcu bzhi pa rmi lam brtag cing ngan na bsrung ba bya ba ni/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ bu kye sang ni dkyil 'khor dag /mthong bar 'gyur ro nyol zhig dang / /rmi lam mthong ba gang yin pa/ /de kun nga la drang por smros/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'am/ yang na rang gi gnas khang yid du 'ong ba la sogs par bde ba'i mal zhig bcas nas nyal bar bya ste/ spyi rgyud las/ ku sha btings pa'i sa gzhi la/ /shar phyogs mgo bltas nyal du gzhug /ces gsungs pa ltar slob dpon gyi byin pa'i ku sha chung ba sngas su 'phred dang / che ba stan du dkyus la btings la/ gos dri ma med pa gyon nas mgo shar ram bla ma'i phyogs su stan la nyal bar bya ste/ mgon po mya ngan 'das gzims ltar/ /'dod pa'i phyogs su nyal bar bya/ /shes bzhin myur du ldang sems la/ /thog ma nyid du nges par sbyar/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang gi glo g.yas pa 'og tu phab la seṅge'i nyal stabs kyis nyal te/ sems la 'dod chags la sogs pa dug gsum gyi rnam rtog rgyang ring du dor la/

lha dang bla ma yid la dran bzhin pas/ sang nyin yi dam lha'i dkyil 'khor chen po ji lta bu zhig mthong bar 'gyur snyam pa'i dga' spro dung nge ba'i sgo nas dran shes bzhin dang ldan par nyal na/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis lung ston par 'gyur bas/ de yang tho rangs kyi cha'i rmi lam brtag dgos pas/ de la rmi lam bzang po'i ltas ni/ rang gi sems la dbang thob dang / /sna tshogs sprul pa lta bu dang / /'gro gang dbang du 'dus pa dang / /rdzu 'phrul dag gis 'gro ba dang / /sa la mi thogs chur mi bying / /nam mkha' dag la bya bzhin 'phur/ /sems can mang po bsgral ba dang / /g.yul ngo dag las rab rgyal ba/ /ces dang / spyi rgyud las kyang / rmi lam sangs rgyas mthong na ni/ /yon tan rgya mtsho mngon sum bzhin/ /mchod rten dang ni sku gzugs mthong / /de la mchod pa rtsom pa dang / /dge slong dag la chos nyan nam/ /yang na ma nyan na yang rung / /chos ni rnam par spyod pa dang / /de bzhin mdo sde rnam par spyod/ /ces sogs mang du gsungs pas na rmi lam du rang gi sems la dbang thob nas rdzu 'phrul gyis sprul pa sna tshogs ston pa/ nam mkha' la 'phur ba/ ri dang sa gzhi sogs la thogs med 'gro ba/ chur mi nub cing sems can mang po dbang du bsdu ba sogs dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs dang / mchod rten mthong zhing / de la mchod pa byed pa/ khyed par rang gi bla ma dang mjal nas chos kyi bka' drin nod pa/ mang po'i dpon du bkur ba/ nyi zla shar ba/ brag phug tu nyi ma lde ba/ lus la ngan skyugs dang / srog chags la sogs pa 'thon zhing gos dkar po dri ma med pa gyon pa sogs rmi na/ rmi lam bzang po yin pas sngags kyi dngos grub rab 'bring 'grub pa'i ltas tsam du shes par byas nas/ zhen chags med pa'i dga' ba sgom par byed/ gal te ngan pa yang 'byung srid pas/ de'i ltas ni rgya skyegs kyi ri la 'dzeg pa/

ka ra wi ra'i me tog rgyas pa 'thu ba/ bye ma'am thal phung la 'dzeg pa/ spre'u dang bong bu la zhon nas kha phyir phyogs nas 'gro ba/ phag dang / rnga mo/ ma he sogs la zhon pa/ bud med nag mo gos nag can la 'dod log spyod pa/ g.yang sa dang / gcong rong du lhung ba/ khyi dang khwa ta/ srin po sogs kyi zos pa/ mi nag po lcags kyi dbyug pa can gyis bsdigs pa/ nyi zla gzas bzung ba/ skra bregs pa/ chus khyer ba/ lus la tir mar gyis byugs pa/ phreng ba dang rgyan dmar pos thod bcings shing lus la btags pa sogs rmi na cung zad ngan pa yin pas gnyid sad ma thag chos thams cad rmi lam gyi snang ba dang khyad par med de yum las/ mya ngan las 'das pa yang rmi lam lta bu/ sgyu ma lta bu/ mya ngan las 'das pa las gzhan pa'i chos zhig yod na'ang rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu zhes gsungs pas/ 'khor 'das kyi chos gang yang don la grub pa cung zad tsam kyang med snyam du bden med kyi sbyang bas rgyas 'debs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi snying po brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa bzlas nas bsrung ba dang / sangs rgyas spyan gyi rnal 'byor bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag las 'byung ba bzhin gyi lung blangs te nyams su len pa dang / gzhan yang spyi rgyud las/ mi dge ba la zhi ba yi/ /sbyin sreg zhi ba'i gsang sngags kyis/ /zhes gsungs pas/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg brgya rtsa la sogs pa'i sgo nas/ rmi lam ngan pa zlog pa'i thabs la brtson par bya dgos pa yin no/ /de rnams kyis slob ma sta gon gyi chos 'khor dang bcas pa legs par grub zin nas dngos gzhi sang nyin skabs su ji ltar bab pa la 'byung bas/ de la mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod nas/ slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang / dpon slob rnams kyi tshogs byin gyis rlabs la/ phud dbul nas longs spyad/ tshogs tha ma dang / lhag ma bstan ma skyong ba rnams nub tha ma kho na'i cho ga'o/

/tshogs lhag rnams bsdus pa logs shig tu bsags/ de nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ byin rlabs bsdus pa gong bzhin dang / sgeg phreng sogs kyis phyi mchod/ rang byung sogs kyis nang mchod/ hūm̐ bde gshegs mnyam nyid sogs kyis bstod pa'i mchod pa rnams sgrub thabs ltar byas nas/ ye shes lnga ldan gyis dngos grub blangs/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang / ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya dang / hūm̐ badzrottiṣṭha sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor pa rnams sang spyan ma drangs kyi bar la/ nam mkhar bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ sgeg phreng sogs gong bzhin/ mchod bstod byas nas mdun gyi gtor mgron rnams gshegs gsol dang brtan bzhugs skabs thob dang bstun par bya/ de nas bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i sogs sngags dang bcas pas lus bsrung / rang gtso bo yab yum du sogs brjod gnas gsum bsrung la/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis sogs bya'o// //gnyis pa dngos gzhi la dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa dang / dbang bskur ba gnyis kyis/ dang po ni/ sta gon gyi maṇḍal bsal ba'i sar/ 'di'i bris sku rab gnas can zhal gang du phyogs pa'am gnas khang gi skabs thob dang bstun nas dgram/ de'i mthar spyi mchod/ sgos mchod rnams sta gon las mi nyung ba sgor mchod/ yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi mchod gtor/ sngon 'gro gtor ma rnams sta gon bzhin dang / phyi rol pa'i mchod gtor/ slob mnyam la bskur ba'i phyir/ gdong g.yog me tog phreng ba/ dbu rgyan/ rdo rje dril bu rnams slob ma du yod kyi grangs dang mnyam pa/ thun mong du/ dung chos su rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu dang / nang mchod nas bdud rtsi cung zad bsres nas blug pa'i mna' chu/ gu gul nag po/ yungs dkar/ stegs ji ltar rung ba'i steng du/

rigs lnga sogs la dgos pa'i mchod pa lnga'i lha bshos rgyab dang / dkar me mdun du drug tshar re/ de gnyis kyi bar du me tog bdug spos/ dri chab gsum bshams la/ mchod pa re tshar ba dang me tog sogs kyi kha gsos mdzad/ gser la sogs pa'i mig thur/ me long / mda' gzhu/ 'bud dung / rgyud kyi po ti 'khor lo gsang dbang gi rdzas nang mchod nas yin/ snam sbyar rnams phyag len bzhin bshams la/ slob dpon grogs dang bcas pa gral la 'khod nas/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / mchod pa byin rlabs/ rnga byin dbab rnams gong bzhin bya/ de nas skyabs 'gro nas bzung ste/ lha bskyed pa'i tshe/ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi hūm̐ sngon po de dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du babs pa las spha ra ṇa phaṭa sogs nas/ ru lu brjod pa'i bar byas la/ dbus su bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal/ sogs kyis bdag mdun tha mi dad chen po'i tshul gyis bzlas la bsdu ba'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin nyams su blangs la/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las bye ba'i gtso bo gnyis par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ de nas bsgrub khang gi phyi rol du stegs ji ltar rigs pa la/ dbus su zlum gtor gcig de'i mthar chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga sgor mchod sogs dgos pa'i yo byad rnams phyag len bzhin bshams la gtor ma chus sbyangs/ 'khyil pas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs te/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod pa dang gtor ma rnams zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ngag tu/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba dbang dang ldan/ /snying rje thabs mkhas thugs dam dkyil po che/ /lha dang drang srong yi dwags srin po klu/ /rig 'dzin rgyal po dang ni gnod sbyin dag

/de dag so so'i dbang po'i skur ston cing / /phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba bzhugs su gsol/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i slad du spyan 'dren gyi/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod kyi gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ padma ka ma la ya satwaṃ gyis gdan dbul/ oṃ ind+ra zhes pa nas sa pa ri wā ra'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin gyi mjug las sa ma ya satwaṃ dang rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas dam la bzhag yang ind+ra sogs kyi rjes la so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhu paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ gandhaṃ swā hā zhes pas mchod la/ tshigs bcad re re'i mjug tu dril bu gsil zhing / dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha/ /lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /me de bsreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po༞ shar lho me lha'i tshogs༞ mchod cing༞ gshin rje be con 'chang ba'i lha/ /ma mo'i rgyal po༞ lho phyogs༞ mchod cing༞ bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha/ /srin po'i rgyal po༞ lho nub༞ mchod cing༞ zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha/ /klu yi rgyal po༞ nub phyogs༞ mchod cing༞ rlung de srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha/ /rigs 'dzin rgyal po༞ nub byang༞ mchod cing༞ gnod sbyin lag na dbyug tho thogs/ /nor skyong rgyal po༞ byang phyogs༞ mchod cing༞ dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha/ /'byung po'i rgyal po༞ byang shar༞ mchod cing༞ steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang / /nyi ma zla ba gza' chen po/ /gza' dang rgyu skar bcas pa la/ /mchod cing༞ 'og gi klu de sa yi bdag /sa 'dzin lag pa chen po dang / /dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhes pas bstod la/ lag gnyis nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ ind+ra ya/ agna ye/ ya mā ya/ nai ri ta ye/ wa ru ṇā ya/

bā ya we/ ku bhe rā ya/ ī shwa rā ya/ uddhaṃ brahmā ya/ sūrya gra ha/ a dhi pa ta ye/ tsand+ra nakṣa tra/ a dhi pa ta ye/ a dhwa pṛ thi wī bhyaḥ a su re bhyaḥ nā ge bhyaḥs pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhṇe daṃ ba lyā di swāhā/ lan gsum gyi dbul la/ g.yas rdo rje snying kha dang / g.yon dril bu gsil zhing / shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po dang / /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang / /dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang / /steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang / /lha rnams kun dang gang dag sa steng klu/ /ri yi lha dang gtsang ma'i tshogs bcas la/ /swa swa so sor gtor ma phul ba 'di/ /rab tu dges shing yid kyis bzhes nas su/ /rang rang phyogs su legs par bsnams nas kyang / /rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun bcas/ /nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas thabs gcig tu/ /phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug par bcas/ /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul gyi/ /'di dag gsol zhing legs par bsnams nas kyang / /bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung / /rgyu de de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /de la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsungs/ /sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin/ /yid kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /thams cad du ni sdom pa legs/ /thams cad bsrung ba'i dge slong dag /sdug bsngal kun las de grol lo/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/

/rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la bsrungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces dang / dpal ldan bla ma sogs nas dngos grub sgrub pa'i stong grogs mdzod kyi bar sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin brjod cing phrin las bcol/ de'i bar la sgrub g.yog pas zhal zas nas rim pa bzhin bsdus te gtor mar blug mchod yon gtor ma la bskor nas gang du bskyal ba'i sa phyogs la gtor/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang / ma 'byor ba sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ badzra muḥ phyogs skyong ba khyed rnams sgrub khang gi phyogs bcur 'khod nas bar chad thams cad bsrung ba'i las mdzad/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod cing bdud rtsis dpon slob gnyis ka'i gnas gsum du reg cing bsrung / sarba bi ghnān gatstsha zhes dang / slob dpon gyi rdo rje gsor dril bu drag myur dkrol/ ru lu brjod/ gzhan rnams kyis rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas bgegs bskrad/ gtor ma sa gtsang sar bskyal/ nang du sleb pa dang / slob dpon gyis yig brgya brjod cing g.yas rdo rje thugs kha dang / g.yon dril bu bcad gtub du dkrol zhing / dkyil 'khor la lan gsum bskor nas shar phyogs su 'greng ste/

ma 'byor ba dang sogs nas lhag chad kha bskang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa'i bar gyi dang 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa dbang bskur ba la yang / slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang / slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ slob dpon gyi mdun du maṇḍal sogs dgos pa'i yo byad 'dus byas la/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rang gis dbang bskur pa'i slob dpon du mos la/ las kyi bum pa'i chu 'thung zhing / ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyi khrus byas nas/ 'jug pa'i yon du maṇḍal phul zhing gsol ba btab pa sogs phal cher 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin thams cad rdzogs par bya zhing / cung zad mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ las kyi bya ba thams cad gtso bo'i thugs kha nas sprul pa'i he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zhig gis mdzad par bsgom/ maṇḍal 'bul dus/ dang po dang / tha ma la tshig rgyas pa brjod cing / gzhan rnams la maṇḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung gcig lha mi'i dpal 'byor sogs kyis dbul/ dbang rdzas rdor dril/ dbu rgyan/ bum pa tsam ma gtogs/ gzhan rnams rang tshig gi don dgos pa yid kyis bsams par bya'o/ /de nas bsrung ba'i gtor ma 'bul dgos rnams rang rang gi phyag len bzhin skabs 'dir 'bul lo/ /gnyis pa slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba la/ 'jug pa dang / dbang dngos/ dang po la phyi nang gnyis kyi dang po ni/ slob ma rnams khrus byas phyag rgya dang yon phul nas/ sta gon gyi gral rim nang 'khod pas/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkram bsdu tshar ba dang / slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces brjod de/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du zab pa las kyang ches shin tu zab pa'i dbang bskur ba gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang /

chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa yang / skye rabs las/ rab tu dma' ba'i stan la 'dug /dul ba'i dpal ni nye bar bzhag /dga' dang ldan pa'i mig gis blta/ /tshig gi bdud rtsi'i 'thung ba bzhin/ /rim gro bskyed de chos nyon cig /ces bya ba la sogs pa/ theg pa chen po'i gzhung lugs dri ma med pa rnams nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsungs pa'i lam rnams kyi nang nas shin tu zab pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam yin zhing / de la gsang sngags snga 'gyur dang / phyi 'gyur tsam gyi dbang du byas na 'di snga 'gyur rnying ma'i lugs yin la/ rnying ma 'di nyid la lam srol bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig yod na'ang / da lan skabs su bab pa/ dpal chen khrag 'thung gi rgyal po he ru ka lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba yin zhing / spyir gyis gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam thams cad smin grol gnyis su 'dus te/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ smin pa dang ni grol ba'i lam/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bstan pa'i mchog /ces dang / chos rje sa skya paṇḍi tas kyang / rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob 'dod na/ /smin grol gnyis la 'bad par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas smin grol gnyis su 'dus shing / de la thog mar smin byed kyi dbang bskur ba sngon du 'gro dgos/ de la yang rgyud sde bzhi po re re nas dbang gi babs mi 'dra ba re gsungs pa las/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i skabs su smin byed dbang bzhi dang / grol byed kyi lam rim pa gnyis gtso bor gyur pa la dgongs nas/ chos rje sa skya paṇḍi tas/ dbang bzhi dang ni rim pa gnyis/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i khyad chos yin/ /zhes gsungs shing / spyir dbang bskur ba'i phan yon ni/ 'grel chen sgron gsal las/ dngos grub thams cad ni dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba nyid las 'byung bar 'gyur ro/

/zhes gsung zhing / chos rje sa paṇa gyis kyang / des nas gang zag dbang po rab/ /dbang bskur nyid kyis grol bar gsungs/ /dbang gis grol bar ma nus pa'i/ /gang zag gzhan la bsgom dgos so/ /zhes gsungs pas/ gang zag dbang po yang rab ind+ra bhu ti lta bu rnams/ dbang rjes de ma thag par grol bar 'gyur ba dang / phyag chen thig le las/ dang por re shig slob ma la/ /dbang rnams lan gcig bskur ba yis/ /de tshe gsang chen bshad pa yi/ /nges par snod du 'gyur ba 'o/ /zhes dbang gi grol bar ma nus pa'i gang zag rnams la grol byed kyi lam bsgom pa'i snod du rung bar byed pa'i thabs kyang dbang nyid yin par gsungs pas na dbang nyid rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa bar grub pa'i phyir dang / gzhan yang phyag chen theg le las/ ji ltar dug la rab sngags kyis/ /dag par byas na bdud rtsir 'gyur/ /de bzhin slob ma dbang sogs kyis/ /lus ni dri ma med par 'gyur/ /zhes dbang bskur bas sdig sgrib thams cad 'dag par bshad cing / ye shes thig le las/ dbang bskur gyis ni 'khor lo sgyur/ /the tshom med pa byed par 'gyur/ /zhes gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu rig pa 'dzin pa dang / 'khor lo sgyur ba la sogs pa dman pa dang / 'bring gi dngos grub thams cad kyang dbang nyid las 'grub pas na/ yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung khungs su gyur pa dbang nyid yin no/ /des na deng sang gang zag rab 'bring thams cad smin byed kyi dkyil 'khor ni rgyud sde rnam par dag pa nas gsungs pa'i rdul tshon nam ras bris nyid yin te/ chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ deng sang gang zag rab 'bring kun/ /rdul tshon gyi ni dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bskur bya bar gsungs mod kyis/ /gzhan gyi smin byed rgyud las bkag /ces gsungs pas/ rdul tshon dngos su bstan zhing / zhar la rgyud sde nas gsungs pa'i ras bris mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa bskur dgos pa yin gyi/

de ma yin pa'i rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs la sogs pas smin byed kyi go mi chod de/ sa skya paṇḍi tas/ gang zag rab 'bring gsum ka la/ /phag mo'i byin rlabs smin byed du/ /rgyud sde kun las gsungs pa med/ /ces dang / rje btsun rin po ches kyang / bla ma brgyud pa dang ldan rgyud don rig /dam tshig mchog bsrung man ngag du mas brgyan/ /snying rjes rgyud brlan bstan bcos du ma shes/ /de yi zhabs bsten gsol ba lan mang btab/ /de yis gnang nas dkyil 'khor chen po ru/ /zhugs nas dbang bzhi po rnams rdzogs par blang / /byin rlabs phra mo tsam gyi ma yin te/ /sngags kyi rtsa ba dbang bskur yin pas so/ /zhes gsung / yang chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ smin par byed pa'i dbang bskur yang / /bla ma brgyud pa ma nyams shing / /cho ga 'khrugs par ma gyur pa/ /phyi nang rten 'brel bsgrig mkhyen cing / /sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs nus pa/ /sangs rgyas gsung bzhin mdzad pa yi/ /bla ma btsal la dbang bzhi blangs/ /de yis sdom pa gsum ldan 'gyur/ /zhes dang / des na snying gtam 'di ltar yin/ dbang bskur chos sgo tsam ma yin/ /gsang sngags rten 'brel lam byed pas/ /rten 'brel bsgrig pa'i gdams ngag yin/ /phung po khams dang skye mched la/ /sangs rgyas sa bon btab nas ni/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas byed pa yi/ /thabs la dbang bskur zhes su btags/ /zhes dang / rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs nas/ /dbang bskur las gzhan chos med do/ /des na thub pas rgyud sde las/ /dbang bskur kho na bsngags pa dang / /mkhas rnams ci nas dbang bskur la/ gus pa'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin/ /zhes sogs smin byed kyi dbang nyid shin tu gal che bar gsungs pas na/ de lta bu'i dbang la nan tan du byed dgos te/ dbang ma thob par gsang sngags zab mo'i lam rnams nyams su blang kyang / phan yon med pa'i khar nyes dmigs chen po skyed par byed de/

dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ dbang bskur med par rgyud 'chad dang / /zab mo'i de nyid sgom byed pa/ /de don legs par shes na yang / /dmyal bar 'gyur gyis grol ba min/ /zhes dang / chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ dbang bskur med kyang lam zab mo/ /bsgom nas sangs rgyas 'grub snyam na/ /dbang bskur med par lam zab mo/ /bsgom na ngan 'gro'i rgyu ru gsungs/ /zhes dang / phyag rgya chen po thig le las/ dbang ma bskur la dngos grub med/ /bye ma btsir yang mar med bzhin/ /gang zhig rgyud lung nga rgyal gyis/ /dbang bskur med par 'chad byed pa/ /slob dpon slob ma shi ma thag /dngos grub thob kyang dmyal bar skye/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /bla ma la ni dbang nod zhu/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dbang gi rgyud yongs su smin par/ rgyud 'chad pa dang / bskyed rdzogs kyi lam zab mo'i don rnams bsgoms kyang / dngos grub thob par mi 'gyur zhing / brgya nang na 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub phra mo re tsam thob srid na'ang / phyi ma ngan song du dpon slob gnyis ka 'gro bar gsungs pa dang / yang sdom gsum las/ de bzhin dbang bskur ma thob pa/ /de la rig 'dzin sdom pa med/ /sdom med de yis dge spyad kyang / /bar ma yin gyi gsang sngags kyi/ /sdom pa las byung dge ba min/ /sdom pa'i dge ba ma yin na/ /gsang sngags thabs lam rab zab kyang / /'tshang mi rgya bar thub pas gsungs/ /zhes pa la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab par gsungs pas na/ dbang la 'bad dgos te/ sa paṇa gyis/ des na cho ga gzhan dag la/ /'bad pa chen po byed bzhin du/ /dbang bskur cho ga 'dor byed pa/ /thabs la bslu ba'i bdud yod ces/ /gsung pa 'dir yang dran par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas na/ blo gros dang ldan pa dag dbang la shin tu gus pa'i sgo nas 'bad rtsol drag po bya dgos so/ /'o na dbang bskur thob pa'i phan yon ji lta bu zhig yod snyam na/ gsang ba'i mdzod las/

dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na/ /skye zhing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ /de yis skye ba bdun na ni/ /ma bsgoms par yang dngos grub thob/ /ces gang zag mchog ma yin kyang / dbang nyid rtag tu goms par byas na/ lam gzhan la ma ltos par skye ba bdun nas mchog gi dngos grub thob par gsungs pa dang / slob dpon padmas dam tshig lnga pa las/ gal te ltung ba med gyur na/ /skye ba bcu drug dag na 'grub/ /ces dbang thob nas rtsa ltung gis ma gos na skye ba bcu drug nas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub 'grub par gsungs shing / sa skya paṇḍi ta chen pos/ des na dbang bskur thob pa de/ /bsrung zhing 'phel bar byed pa la/ /bsgom pa zhes su btags pa yin/ /zhes grol byed kyi lam yang / dbang dus su thob pa'i rgyun de goms par byed pa'i thabs yin par gsungs pas na/ dbang bskur pa nyid sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba yin pas/ rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don thams cad bde blag tu bsgrub pa'i thabs zab mo mngon par dbang bskur ba sgrub par byed pa la/ sta gon du gnas pa dang / dngos gzhir gnas pa gnyis las/ sta gon gyi chos dgos pa 'khor dang bcas pa kha sang gi gnas skabs su legs par grub zin/ dngos gzhi la slob dpon gyi bya ba dang / slob ma la bya ba gnyis las/ dang po slob dpon gyi bya ba la dkyil 'khor 'di nyid bdag mdun tha mi dad du bskyed nas sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te/ phyi nang gsang gsum dang bstod pa/ 'dzab rnams kyi mchod pas mchod nas/ rang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las gtso bo gnyis par bye nas phyi rol du 'byung po'i tshogs gtor mas tshim parabyas te/ slob dpon gyis nang du log nas slob ma la dbang ji tsam bskur ba bdag 'jug gi tshul du rdzogs par blang dgos pa sogs sngon du song nas/ da slob ma la bya ba 'jug pa dang / dbang dngos gnyis las/ dang po 'jug pa la phyi nang gnyis kyi dang po ni/

slob dpon la dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo he ru ka dang gnyis su med par mos nas 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ zhes brjod la 'bul du gzhug de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzad par zhu/ sangs rgyas kun dngos bde ba'i mchog /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i gar mdzad pa/ /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /skal bzang lha mo'i tshogs bcas pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'dud/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i ched du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod sogs kyi dmigs pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /sogs dang / bde gshegs rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas/ /sogs lan gsum re sta gon bzhin brjod du gzhug de ltar dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams bzung bar khas blangs nas/ khyed rang rnams sngon chad dpal he ru ka lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'am/ mthong kyang bskyar nas 'jug pa'i mtshon byed du ras yug dmar po res gdong bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ tsakṣu bandha wa rā ma na ya hūm̐ gis gdong bcing / dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba de'i tshe phyag stong par mjal du mi rung bas na u dum wa ra la sogs pa'i me tog gi phreng ba re yang byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis me tog phreng ba gtad/ de nas slob dpon gyi thugs kha nas khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ khyed rnams la dbang bskur ba la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐ tshindha tshindha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang / las bum gyi chu ku shas gtor la bgegs bskrad/ de nas khyed rnams la 'dod pa dri ba yin te/

bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ /zhes dris pa'i lan btab par mos pa mdzad nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ /'dun pa nges par bya ba'i slad du/ de yis bu la ci zhig bya/ /zhes dris pa'i lan du/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /zhes lan btab la/ de nas bden gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya'o snyam pa'i kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dungs pa re bsgom mdzod/ de las langs pa'i sems de nyid snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa nya gang ba lta bu re gsal lam byung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba bde stong nam mkha' lta bu'o snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de nyid gzugs kyi rnam par langs pa las byung ba'i zla ba'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba dang bcas pa ste/ zla ba ni kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems rdo rje ni don dam byang chub kyi sems te bden pa gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpa ta yā mi/ de nyid slob dpon gyi snying khar rdo rje bzhag pa'i sgo nas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ su ra ti sa ma ya satwaṃ/ ho siddhi badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ de ltar sems bskyed pa de dang / gzhan yang 'og nas 'byung ba'i gsang sngags kyi kun tu spyod pa rnams snod dang mi ldan pa rnams kyi mdun du ma smra zhig ces gsang bar gdams pa yin te/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/

ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /zhes brjod cing rdo rje spyi bor bzhag de nas khyed rang rnams slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus te dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas zhugs pa'i mos pa byas nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs la dbu dud pa dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi nang du khrid pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de rnams kyi sgo nas phyi'i 'jug pa song nas/ gnyis pa nang du 'jug pa la sngon du 'gro ba dam la bzhag pa bzhi dang / dngos gzhi ye shes dbab ba gnyis las/ dang po phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dkyil 'khor mchog dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas 'dir/ /ma zhugs dad pa med rnams la/ /nam yang smra bar ma byed cig /gal te smras par gyur na ni/ /dngos grub nyams par 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes dang / gnyis pa nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ snying khar rdo rje bzhag la/ rgyal ba kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /dam tshig 'di las gang 'das pa/ /khrag 'thung 'bar ba'i tshogs bcas kyi/ /khros nas snying khrag thod par 'thung / /zhes dang / gsum pa gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa'am/ mna' chu sbyin pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ gong du bsham pa'i dung chos kyi mna' chu sbyin la/ 'di khyod rdo rje'i dam tshig yin/ /ma srung dmyal bar sreg byed cing / /bsrung na dngos grub thob 'gyur ba'i/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi chu 'thungs shig /pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥ bzhi pa bla ma'i bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng phyin chad bu khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyis ngas 'di byos shig ces bya ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so/ /nga la yang brnyas par ma byed cig byas na ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas sems can dmyal ba chen por ltung bar gyur ta re zhes brjod/

de ltar dam la bzhag nas/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon tu maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shog dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas khyed rang rnams dngos po dang mtshan ma gang la yang ma zhen par/ lus kyi spyod lam tsog pu'i tshul gyis phan tshun gcig la gcig ma reg par 'dug cing / sems kyi stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams skad cig gi he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i sku can du gsal lam gyis mos nas yod pa'i rkang pa gnyis bgrad pa'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu bdungs pa lta bu yaṃ dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ rkang mthil gnyis su yi ge dzhaiṃḥljang gu re re/ sum mdor raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ dang me 'bar bas mtshan pa/ snying khar laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po zur bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pa dang lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ mgrin par baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pa dang āḥs mtshan pa/ spyi bor yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba 'khrigs pa lta bu'i dbus su has mtshan pa ste 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gsal btab/ slob dpon la dpal chen he ru ka dngos yin snyam du gus 'dud drag po dung pa cig byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi rkang 'og gi rlung la phog pas/ de g.yos/ rkang mthil gnyis kyi dzhaiṃḥmer 'bar te/ long bu'i rtsa nang nas zhugs/ brla'i rtsa bo che na yar dmar khyug khyug song bas sum mdo'i me dang khrug chil gyis 'dres nas/ cher 'bar ba'i stobs kyis/ snying kha'i sa'i dkyil 'khor tsha lam lam bsros/ de'i stobs kyi mgrin pa'i chu'i dkyil 'khor skya thi li li bkol ba'i rlangs pa gyen du song bas/

spyi bo'i rlung g.yos thur du bus pas mgrin pa'i chu'i zegs ma snying kha'i sa la thim pas/ bde ba dang lte ba'i me 'bar bas drod skyes te/ snying khar bde drod 'dzom pa la brten nas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de'i dus su rkang 'og gi rlung gis gyen la bteg ha cang nam mkha' la 'gro na/ spyi bo'i rlung gi thur du mnan te/ lus bar snang la 'dar yed yed gnas pa la/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de dag gi thugs kha nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo/ bcom ldan 'das dpal chen he ru ka lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa can/ che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba rdul phran tsam gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo dang ba spu'i bu ga nas/ kha ba chen po 'bab pa bzhin du sib sib sib thim pa la brten nas/ dbang gi ye shes khyad par can rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ gu gul gyis bdug cing rol mo'i sgra drag tu byas te/ hūm̐ āḥha dzhaiṃḥlan gsum gyi mjug tu/ tiṣṭha ma hā kro dha ā be sha ya/ ā be sha ya/ staṃ bha ya/ staṃ bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsā la ya/ tsā la ya/ hūm̐ āḥha dzhaiṃḥzhes pa lan mang du brjod/ de lta bu'i ye shes pa de nyid/ sku babs na 'phar g.yo/ gsung phebs na rgod pa dang ngag saṃ skṛ ta'i skad smra ba/ thugs babs na dus gsum shes pa la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur bas/ ngo shes par gyis la lam du srol bar gyis shig de lta bu'i ye shes pa de nyid slob dpon gyi spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag pa'i sgo nas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag nas/

tiṣṭha badzra brjod cing brtan par bya'o/ /de nas dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i slad du khyed rang rnams mig mig ras dang bcas bzhin pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi bar snang la ltas pas/ mig lam du kha dog gang mthong ba de nged la smra dgos pas/ kye khyed kyi mig lam du kha dog ci snang zhes dris la/ dkar po mthong na zhi ba'i las 'grub/ de bzhin du ser po rgyas pa/ dmar po dbang / sngon po'am nag po mngon spyod dam drag po/ ljang gu'am/ sna tshogs khra bor mthong na las sna tshogs 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan te/ sta gon gyi so shing gi skabs su lung bstan pa dang mthun na/ shin tu 'grub nye ba'i ltas yin gsung / de nas khyed rang rnams kyi phyag na yod pa'i me tog gi phreng ba rnams thogs te/ gral rim bzhin bzhengs nas/ 'di na bcom ldan 'das dpal chen po he ru ka lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te/ de yang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes yongs su dag pa gcig nyid/ gdul bya 'dul ba'i ched du/ gtso bo dang 'khor gyi lha'i rnam pa can du bstan pa tsam ma gtogs/ ngo bo la bzang ngan ci yang med mod/ 'on kyang rang gi tshe rabs snga ma nas las 'brel bsags pa'i lha gcig la 'bab par shog snyam pa'i dad pa sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ pra tītstsha badzra hoḥ zhes gsung zhing / 'bul ba'i stangs ka re mdzod cig ces bsgos la phul te/ slar me tog de nyid slob dpon gyis blangs te/ slob ma'i spyi bo la bzhag la/ oṃ pra ti gṛhṇa satwaṃ i maṃ sa twa ma hā ba la/ zhes pas me tog phreng bas dbang bskur la/ de nas slob dpon gyis slob ma'i mig ras bsal te/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur te/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /he badzra pa shya/ zhes pa ni/ kye zhes slob ma la bos nas/ rdo rje ltos shig ces bskul ba yin pas/

dkyil 'khor la legs par gzigs shig ces bsgos tshar ba dang / de ltar na khyod rang rnams kyis pra tītstsha sogs kyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha la me tog phul/ slob dpon gyis pra ti gṛhṇa sogs kyis me tog spyi bor bcings nas dbang dang po me tog phreng ba'i dbang bskur/ he ru ka dpal sogs kyi mig ras phye ste/ mi shes pa'i mig gi rab rib bsal nas/ thar pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du gzigs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang dkyil 'khor blta bar bskul ba ni/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /shes rab rnam gsum rab tu bskyed/ /khyed ni thugs kyi rigs su skyes/ /bde bar gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs/ /dngos grub thams cad mngon du 'gyur/ /'gro ba rigs drug thams cad la/ /bya bzhin snying rje kun la bskyed/ /gsang ba'i chos la dad par gyis/ /zhes dkyil 'khor blta bar bskul te/ gang la blta ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ dpal chen khrag 'thung gi rgyal po he ru ka lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor yin te/ de yang phyi rol du rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla bre/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i stegs bu la gnas pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi/ rta babs bzhi dang bcas pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du bde ba chen po'i byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin dkar dmar 'dres pa'i mdog can zla gam sgo gcig pa/ dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad du re re gnas pa'i dbus su padma/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ drag po pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du padma nyi ma ro'i gdan re re ste/ rten gzhal yas khang pa dang / brten pa lha ni dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal chen he ru ka sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/

zhal g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ dbus mthing kha/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis kha ṭwāṃ ga dang / rnga chung / g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis thod khrag dang / rgyu zhags rnams 'dzin zhing / yum khro mo dbang phyug ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi gdan gyi steng du/ shar du gau rī sngon mo g.yas dbyug pa/ g.yon bandha/ lhor tsau rī ser mo phyag gnyis mda' gzhu 'gengs tshul mdzad pa/ nub tu pra mo ha dmar mo g.yas rgyal mtshan/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ byang du betta lī ljang nag g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon byi ro 'dzin pa/ shar lhor pukka sī dmar ser phyag gnyis kyi rgyu zhags 'dren pa/ lho nub tu ghasma rī ljang gu g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ nub byang du dur khrod ma mthing nag g.yas dpag bsam gyi shing / g.yon mi snying 'dzin pa/ byang shar du tsaṇḍa lī ser skya g.yas rtse gsum/ g.yon mi ro 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa ste/ mdor na he ru ka lha dgu'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad mngon sum bzhin du gzigs pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de rnams kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams song nas/ gnyis pa zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba dngos la/ bum dbang / gsang dbang / shes rab ye shes/ bzhi pa'i dbang rnams las/ dang po la slob ma'i dbang dang / slob dpon gyi dbang gnyis kyi dang po/ rig pa'i dbang lnga/ brtul zhugs dang drug las/ thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba maṇḍal dbul zhing gsol ba btab pa/ bgegs bskrad ste shis pa brjod pa rnams las/ dang po rdo rje slob ma'i dbang zhu ba'i phyir du maṇḍal zhig 'bul ba zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ khyod ni he ru ka dpal te/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi bde stsol mdzad/

/byang chub sems dpa' che rnams kyi/ /yang dag don mchog rnam dag pa/ /ji ltar de nyid bdud rtsi yis/ /dbang gi mchog ni bskur ba bzhin/ /de bzhin bdag la 'khor ba yi/ /sdug bsngal rnams ni sel bar mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdud rtsi dri ma med/ /ma rig pa yi rab rib 'joms/ /gang gi byang chub bla na med/ /de ring bdag gis thob par mdzod/ /de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ khyed rang rnams slob dpon la he ru ka dngos yin snyam du gus 'dud drag po dung pa re byas pas/ slob dpon gyi snying kha nas 'od 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad bsregs shing sbyang nas/ lus 'od kyi gong bu gcig tu gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nyid slob dpon gyi oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharma swa bhā shuddho haṃ/ zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma nyi ma'i steng du/ khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid hūm̐ mthing nag de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ khyed rang rnams skad cig gis he ru ka sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhal g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ dbus mthing nag phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas 'og ma gnyis kyis kha ṭwāṃ ga dang / rnga chung / g.yon 'og ma gnyis kyis thod khrag dang / rgyu zhags rnams 'dzin zhing / yum khro mo dbang phyug ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po thugs khar hūm̐ sngon po re gsal lam ste yod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad he ru ka yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la gnyis su med par thim/ yang khyed rang rnams slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la gus 'dud byas pas/

de dag gi thugs kha nas khro bo dang khro mo dpag tu med pa spros/ dbang bskur ba la bar du gcod pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par mos mdzod byas la/ gu gul gyis bdug yungs dkar gyis brab/ rol mo drag tu bya zhing / a mṛ ta brjod/ de nas las kyi rdo rjes rnam rgyal bum pa bteg la slob ma'i phyogs su g.yo ba dang bcas pas bzung / slob dpon gyi dril bu bsil zhing me tog dor la/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas padma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po'o/ /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams pa zhi byed pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa yin/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /lha dang mi dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa yin/ /de rnams kyis sngon du 'gro ba song nas/ dngos gzhi dbang dngos la/ dang po chu'i dbang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ kro dha a mṛ ta dang las bum gyi chu ku shas slob ma dang dbang rdzas la gtor nas bsang ba 'og ma rnams la'ang 'gre/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ khyed rnams kyi rnam shes kyi phung po dang / dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang rnams dang / dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu gnyis ka badzra he ru ka sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/

gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐ḥ slob dpon gyi thugs kha nas 'od 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad he ru ka yab yum gyi rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khyed rang rnams dang / dbang rdzas lhar bskyed pa la thim/ slob dpon gyi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha khro bo rigs lnga yab yum 'khor bcas badzra ma mā dzaḥ zhes pas skur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs la/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ slob dpon gyis ku shas rnam rgyal bum pa dang las bum gyi chu de nyid nas cung zad gtor/ de bzhin du dbang 'og ma rnams la'ang dbang rdzas de la rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu nas thor pa re mdzad do/ /……oṃ badzri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ḥzhes gsung zhing dbang rdzas la dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las badzra he ru ka yab yum gyis dbu brgyan/ dam rdzas kyi badzra he ru ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ dbang gi lha la gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams dang slob dpon gyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas/ khyed rang rnams la dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ dpon slob rnams kyis dbyangs dang bcas pas/……sangs rgyas kun gyi bum pa'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun tu rab sgrub phyir/ /bum pa'i bdud rtsis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badzri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur zhes pa nas/ dbu brgyan zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin brjod/ rnam rgyal bum pa slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag cing /

bum chu 'thung du gzhug puṣpe sogs mchod pa lngas mchod/ de ltar na badzra he ru ka'i sgo nas chu'i mngon par dbang bskur ba thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ badzra he ru ka'i bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ cod paṇa gyi dbang la/ a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ khyed rnams kyi tshor ba'i phung po dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du āṃ las rin po che āṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros sogs kun la 'gre/ ratna he ru ka ser po/ rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo gri thod 'dzin pa sogs dang / gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes pa gzhug pa/ dbang gi lha la gsol ba btab pa sogs dang / dbang lha zhu ste/ dbang rdzas dbu rgyan du gyur pa/ dbang gi don du gsol ba btab pa rnams gong bzhin byas la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi cod paṇa dbang / /de ring༞ sangs rgyas༞ rin chen cod paṇa dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ ratna mu ka ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes brjod la/ dbu rgyan slob ma rnams kyi spyi bor bcings/ slar yang dbang de brten pa'i don du bum pa'i chus kyang spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ zhes dang ku sha'i rtsa bas rnam rgyal bum chu slob ma rnams kyi spyi bor gtor zhing / oṃ badzri bhā wa sogs nas/ ratna he ru kas dbu brgyan/ zhes pa'i bar dang / mchod pa lngas mchod pa gong bzhin/ de ltar na ratna he ru ka'i sgo nas cod paṇa gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna'i dri ma dag tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ ratna he ru ka'i bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ rdo rje'i dbang la bsang sbyangs/ khyed rnams kyi 'du shes kyi phung po dang /
