dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du/ dzrīṃ las padma dzrīṃ gis mtshan pa sogs padma he ru ka dmar po padma dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum pad ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa sogs dang / gnas gsum byin brlab/ ye shes pa gzhug pa/ dbang gi lha la gsol ba btab pa/ dbang lha zhu nas dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur pa/ dbang gi don du gsol ba btab pa rnams gong bzhin/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring༞ sangs rgyas༞ rdo rje'i dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes brjod la/ rdo rje gsol zhing slob ma'i lag pa g.yas par gtad/ gong bzhin/ bum chus dbang bskur te/ padma he ru kas dbu brgyan pa dang / mchod pas mchod pa sogs byed/ de ltar na padma he ru ka'i sgo nas rdo rje'i mngon par dbang bskur ba thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ padma he ru ka'i bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ dril bu'i dbang la bsang sbyangs/ khyed rnams kyi 'du byed kyi phung po dang / dbang rdzas dril bu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa sogs/ karma he ru ka ljang gu/ ral gri dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang gu/ gri thod 'dzin pa sogs dang / gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes pa gzhug pa/ dbang gi lha la gsol ba btab pa/ dbang lha zhu nas dbang rdzas dril bur gyur pa/ dbang gi don du gsol ba btab pa rnams gong bzhin/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu'i dbang / /de ring༞ sangs rgyas༞ dril bu'i dbang ni sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badzra ghaṇṭe a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes brjod la dril bu dkrol zhing slob ma'i lag pa g.yon par gtad/ gong bzhin bum pa'i chus dbang bskur te/

karma he ru kas dbu brgyan pa dang / mchod pas mchod pa sogs byed/ de ltar na karma he ru ka'i sgo nas dril bu'i mngon par dbang bskur ba thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ karma he ru ka'i bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ ming gi dbang la/ bsang sbyangs/ khyed rnams kyi gzugs kyi phung po mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du bhrūṃ las 'khor lo bhrūṃ gis mtshan pa sogs/ buddha he ru ka dkar po 'khor lo dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa sogs dang / gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes pa gzhug pa/ dbang gi don du gsol ba btab pa gong bzhin/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ming gi dbang / /de ring༞ sangs rgyas༞ rdo rje'i ming gi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badzra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye zhes slob ma rnams la gsang mtshan dris la dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes brjod che ge mo'i tshab tu sngar nas gsang mtshan yod na dang / med na rdo rje'i ming gur nas 'byung ba bzhin gdags par bya'o/ /de nas snga ma bzhin bum chus dbang bskur te buddha he ru kas dbu brgyan pa dang mchod pas mchod pa sogs byed/ de ltar na buddha he ru ka'i sgo nas ming gi mngon par dbang bskur ba thob/ gti mug dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ buddha he ru ka'i bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ brtul zhugs la/ slob ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa sogs dang /

gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes pa bcug pa rnams gong bzhin byas la/ khyed rnams rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin du gnas pa la/ slob dpon gyi hūm̐ dang gser sogs las grub pa'i rdo rje lha nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi rang bzhin/ tshad dang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa re khyed rang rnams la sbyin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu gzung / /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha e ṣa satwaṃ dha ra yā mi/ badzra sa twa hi hi hi hīḥhūm̐ zhes brjod nas/ lag pa g.yas su gtad cing / snying khar 'dzin du bcug la/ de ltar rdo rje snying khar reg pa'i rkyen gyis/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying kha'i nang du yang rdo rje sems dpa' rang 'dra ba mtshon gang pa zhig gi rgyas btab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badzri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ sogs dang / bum chu 'thor tshul tsam gyis dbang bskur te/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan zhes sogs brjod/ de rnams ni rdo rje slob mar dbang bskur ba'o/ /gnyis pa slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i ched du maṇḍal zhig 'bul ba zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum du mdzod/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur ba/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /slob dpon go 'phang rab bsgrub pa'i/ /dbang bskur chen po bdag la stsol/ /de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ khyed rang rnams dbang stegs seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyis gnas pa'i phyag g.yas par/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje re thugs kyi dam tshig slad du byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'di de sogs brjod cing gtad/ rdo rje de nyid gsor te thugs khar 'gying ba dang bcas pas bzung nas rdo rje'i de kho na nyid la thugs gtad par zhu/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/

/rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu la'o/ /oṃ ma hā badzra hūm̐/ rdo rje 'di ni chos kyi dbyings stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin yin la/ rang gi sems kyang stong pa nyid sprod pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba rig stong dbyer med du shes par gyis shig a dang mkhar ba sogs las grub pa'i dril bu lha nyi shu rtsa gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur pa re khyed rang rnams kyi phyag g.yon du gsung gi dam tshig gi slad du byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed/ /ces brjod nas dril bu dkrol zhing gtad/ dril bu de nyid dku g.yon par kha gyen du bstan nas bzung ste/ dril bu'i de kho na nyid la thugs gtad par zhu/ āḥsrid pa ngo bo nyid kyi dag /ngo bo nyid kyi srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa/ /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /oṃ badzra ghaṇṭe a/ dril bu 'di ni srid pa thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa ston pa/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gi ngo bo yin la/ rang gi ngag rnam par dag pa yang de lta bur shes par gyis shig ces brjod/ de nas slob ma rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ dbang stegs kyi steng du hūm̐ las khyed rang rnams dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo he ru ka sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug pa sogs yum dang bcas par gong bzhin bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa bcug khyed rang rnams kyi lus lha sku snang la ma 'gags pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu la sems gtad nas/ phyag gnyis thugs khar 'khyud pa'i stang ka re mdzad cing / phyag rgya'i de kho na nyid brjod pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/

shes rab bcu drug lon pa la/ /lag pa dag gi yang dag 'khyud/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba/ /slob dpon gyi ni dbang du brjod/ /rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zung cig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /zhes brjod/ dbang de rnams brtan pa'i yan lag tu bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la/ /khams gsum pa yi phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /oṃ badzri bhā wa sogs sngar bzhin/ rnam rgyal bum chu nas ku shas slob ma rnams kyi spyi bor 'thor ba sogs bya/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las khro bo rigs lnga res dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la gnyis su med par thim pa de nyid slob dpon gyis rab tu gnas pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzrā ya swa hā/ zhes brjod cing slob ma re re'i mgor me tog gtor/ puṣpe la sogs pa lngas mchod par bya'o/ /de ltar khyod la rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dbang bskur ba 'dis/ khyod kyi phung po dang khams dang skye mched kyi dri ma dag par byas pas de thams cad rang gi sems nyid du 'dus la/ rang gi sems rnam par dag pa nyid rten gyi dkyil 'khor yin te/ dkyil 'khor zhes ni gang bshad pa/ /yid kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa nyid/ /gzhal med khang zhes bshad pa ni/ /sems ni gzhal med khang brtsegs nyid/ /de yi phyi rol gru bzhi ni/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /gang zhig byams pa la sogs sems/ /thig skud bzhir ni brjod pa'o/ /rdo rje thig tu gang bshad pa/ /chos ni rjes su dran pa'o/ /lta ba kun las rnam grol ba/ /ye shes thig tu brjod pa yin/ /rgyan gang yang dag bshad pa ni/ /tshul khrims sogs kyi sdom pa'o/ /dbang po lnga yi sems gang yin/

/rwa ba lnga ni 'byung ba nyid/ /gang zhig sgo bzhir bshad pa ni/ /rnam par thar pa rnam pa bzhi/ /rta babs ka ba bzhi po ni/ /yang dag spong ba bzhi zhes brjod/ /dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi po ni/ /kha khyer bzhir ni brjod pa nyid/ /sgo khyud bzhi ni gang yin pa/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa rnam pa bzhi/ /de bzhin me tog phreng rgyan pa/ /byang chub yan lag bdun po yin/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad po ni/ /ka ba brgyad po zhes brjod do/ /lam gyi ye shes khyad par ni/ /rnga yab tu ni rab tu grags/ /gang zhig do shal bshad pa ni/ /nyon mongs thams cad gcod pa ste/ /kun tu gcod pa'i ngo bo yis/ /nyon mongs 'phrog pa'i drwa ba nyid/ /tshogs gnyis kyi ni sbyor ba yi/ /'khor lo bskor ba gang yin pa/ /nyon mongs phyed ni gcod pas na/ /do shal phyed pa nyid du brjod/ /de dag ni dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid brjod pa yin la/ lha'i de kho na nyid brjod pa ni/ dbus kyi he ru ka yab yum ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ gau rī ni me long lta bu'i ye shes/ tsau rī ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ pra mo ha ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ betta lī ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ pukka sī ni sa rnam par dag pa/ ghasma rī ni chu rnam par dag pa/ shma sha na ni me rnam par dag pa/ tsaṇḍa lī ni rlung rnam par dag pa/ dur khrod brgyad ni rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad dag pa/ srung ba'i 'khor lo ni bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon pa'o/ /de ltar de kho na nyid kyi rnam dag rtogs pa'i slob ma la rjes su gnang ba sbyin dgos pas/ de la thog mar lha mchod pa'i rjes su gnang ba'i phyir/ sgeg sogs brgyad kyi phyag rgya 'di rnams mdzad par zhu zhes dang / dpon slob gnyis kas phyag rgya bya zhing / bla mas/ deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sras dang bcas la rnam rol zhing / /rdo rje snyems ma'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /dga' ston bde ba'i mchod pa gyis/

/aḥ sgeg dang bcas pas phreng ba 'phang / /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /des ni bcom ldan 'bral mi 'gyur/ /phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no/ /oṃ/ lus can kun la dam chos kyi/ /glu ni khyod kyis blang bar bya/ /de yis bde gshegs dngos grub ni/ /myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ /gīḥ de nyid thal mo'i gar gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /sangs rgyas 'du ba'i phrin las kyi/ /gar mkhan tshul du sgyur bar gyis/ /hoḥ rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos legs tshim gyis/ /lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyi ni tshim par gyis/ /hūm̐/ sangs rgyas rnams la me tog gtor/ /byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pa'i/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi/ /bde gshegs sku ni thob par 'gyur/ /bhrūm̐/ chos kyi me ni legs sbar bas/ /rdo rje chos dang 'dra ba ru/ /sems can ma rig bdo ba la/ /ye shes sgron mes gsal bar gyis/ /pra/ rgyal ba rnams la dri phul bas/ /tshul khrims shes rab ting 'dzin dang / /rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yi/ /byang chub lus can rnams la bgos/ /ghaḥ deng phyin chad khyed rnams lus kyi sgo nas sgeg pa dang / ngag gi sgo nas glu len pa sogs spyod lam ci byed pa thams cad/ mi dge ba dang / lung ma bstan ma yin par/ lha mchod pa'i bsam pas zin par gyis shig ces brjod/ sems can gyis don byed pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ praṃ las byung ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin gyi gser drug nam las byas pa'i thur mas mig gi thad kar byugs pa la brten nas/ ma rig pa'i ling thog bsal nas sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu dang ldan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten ling thog bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i/ /ling thog rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badzra nai tra a pa ha ra pa tra laṃ pa hrīḥ

traṃ/ de ltar ma rig pa'i ling thog bsal nas/ chos kyi snang ba thams cad me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar snang la rang bzhin med par shes pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig ces shes pa'i ched du/ a las skyes pa'i me long bstan la/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye/ /zhes brjod/ de ltar chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar shes par ma zad/ sgra thams cad grag stong dril bu'i sgra ltar shes dgos so zhes shes pa'i ched du/ dril bu dkrol zhing / aḥ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la ni mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /zhes brjod/ de ltar shes par byas nas sems can gyi don byed pa la gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab dang ldan yang / thabs mkhas kyi khyad par dang bral na/ nyan rang gi sar ltung bar 'gyur bas/ rang don yid la byed pa'i bsam pa bcom dgos so zhes shes pa'i ched du/ hoḥlas byung ba'i thabs kyi gzhu dang bcas pas shes rab kyi mda' drug phyogs bzhi steng 'og gnyis dang drug tu 'phen tshul byas pa la brten nas/ rang don yid byed pa'i bsam pa thams cad bcom pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ mda' gzhu lag tu gtad cing 'phen tshul byed bcug la/ hoḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su chags par byos shig ces brjod pa dang / slob ma rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su chags par bya'o zer/ de ltar na khyed rnams kyis chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar shes shing / sgra thams cad grag stong dril bu'i sgra lta bur shes nas sems can gyi don byed nus pa de yang /

dbang gi ye shes rdo rje sems dpa' rang bzhin med pa'i tshul gyi khyed rang rnams kyi snying dkyil na bzhugs pa de'i mthu yin no zhes shes pa'i ched dang / me long rdo rje dang bcas pa bstan la/ a badzra satwa/ rdo rje sems dpa' me long ltar/ /gsal shing dag la rnyog pa med/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin gtso/ /gang yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag po byang chub kyi sems 'di yin par shes par gyis shig ces brjod/ chos rnams kyi gnas lugs rtogs shing / rang don yid byed kyi bsam pa dang bral ba de/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi khur bskyed de gdul bya rnams kyi blo dang 'tshams par chos bshad pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don byed dgos so zhes shes pa'i ched du/ chos bshad pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ oṃ badzra he tu maṃ/ zhes brjod cing khyed rang rnams kyi rkang 'og tu 'khor lo dang / oṃ badzra bha ga raṃ zhes brjod cing lag pa g.yas su dung dang / oṃ badzra ghaṇṭe āḥzhes pas g.yon par dril bu/ a zhes lag pa gnyis kyi steng du rgyud kyi po ti yang sbyin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod cing sbyin tshar ba dang / de'i don ni badzra he tu zhes pa rdo rje rgyu ste/ gzhan don sgrub pa'i rgyu byang chub kyi sems dran par byas nas/ sems can 'khor ba las drongs shig pa'i don yin/ 'dren lugs ji ltar byed na/ badzra bha ga raṃ ni rdo rje smra ba ste/ rgyu des kun nas blang ste/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad smra bar gyis shig pa'i don yin/ tshul ji ltar smra na/ ghaṇṭe ni dril bu ste shes rab stong pa nyid kyi sgra sgrog pas zab mo'i de kho na nyid ston pa'i don yin/ chos gang gis na/ a zhes pas rgyud kyi glegs bam byin pas chos 'di'i sgra sgrog par gyis shig ces go bar bya dgos so/ /zhes dang / deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/

/tsam gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /khyod kyi the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /dri med kun tu gang bar gyis/ /sngags spyod tshul gyi cho ga yis/ /skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan 'dogs drin du bzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang / /khyod la rtag tu srung bar mdzad/ /ces brjod/ de ltar chos bshad pa de yang gnas skabs su gdul bya so so'i bsam pa dang mthun par/ theg pa gsum po gang la gang 'dul gyi sgo nas ston dgos kyang / mthar thug de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga dang 'brel ba'i rdo rje theg pa'i chos ston dgos shing / chos ston pa de rnams kyang lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bar bya dgos so zhes shes pa'i ched du/ rigs lnga'i sprul bshad kyi rjes su gnang ba ni/ khyed rang rnams kyang rigs lnga so so'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas phyag rgya 'di rnams kyang mdzad par zhu/ zhes dang / dpon slob gnyis kas phyag rgya bya zhing / bla mas/ sems can kun la thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /zhes brjod la/ de bzhin du/ tshig rkang snga ma gsum 'dra bar byas la/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo/ rin chen 'khor lo/ padma'i 'khor lo/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ sogs rdzogs pa dang / de ltar na khyod kyi sems can thams cad la/ chos kyi 'khor lo/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo/ rin chen 'khor lo/ padma'i 'khor lo/ sna tshogs 'khor lo bskor la chos kyi dung bus/ sgra sgrogs/ bshad pa gyis shig de ltar na khyod kyis bskyed pa ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs te mthong / bum pa'i dbang thob/ gtso bor lus kyi dri ma dag dam tshig rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig bsrung ba dang / lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/

/de nas gnyis pa gsang dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul ba zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ slob dpon dam pa bde gshegs gtso/ /rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang gsum dag pa'i dbang mchog 'di/ /de ring bdag la gnang bar mdzod/ /de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi slob dpon la/ rig ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa re phyag rgyar phul ba'i mos pa mdzad nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ khyod zhabs padmo'i bka' drin gyis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub sems/ /don chen zab mos nyon mongs 'joms/ /de ring bdag la dbab par zhu/ /lan gcig de nas khyed rang rnams sngon chad rdzas gsang ba byang chub kyi sems kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsung zhing mig ras rnams 'ching bar zhu/ slob dpon he ru ka yab yum du gsal ba'i yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ nor bur oṃ/ rtse mor phaṭa dang bcas pa/ yum gyi mkha' āḥlas padma āḥs mtshan pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs thugs khar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu nas sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i thig le dung dang kunda ltar dkar ba de nyid khyed rang rnams kyi lce thog tu bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ bdud rtsi ril bu bsres pa'i nang mchod nas sbyin zhing / byang chub sems kyi rdo rje 'di/ /sems kyi sdug bsngal rnam 'joms te/ /gsang ba'i gnas ni dam pa na/ /de ring khyod la dbab par bya/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ a ho ma hā su kha zhes gsung zhing myangs pa la brten nas mgrin pa na gzhir gnas kyi rtsa ya ra la wa zhes yi ge 'bru bzhi byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba dam tshig pa'i tshul du gnas pa la/

yas byon pa'i byang chub kyi sems de nyid ye shes pa'i tshul du 'dres te/ de nas rim gyis brgyud lus kyi rtsa gnas thams cad la khyab pas/ 'dod chags las gyur pa'i rtog pa sum cu rtsa gsum/ zhe sdang las gyur pa'i rtog pa bzhi bcu/ gti mug las gyur pa'i rtog pa bdun te/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa thams cad 'gags nas gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skyes pa yin snyam du mos nas/ cung zad cig mnyam par 'jog pa zhu/ de nas nga rgyal gzung ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ nga ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /bdag ni bsod nams skal ba che/ /yon tan kun gyis bdag brgyan te/ /he ru ka dpal bdag nyid do/ /lan gcig brjod/ de nas dbang de thob pa'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsung zhing mig ras 'grol bar zhu/ de ltar na yum gyi bha ga nas gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gtso bor ngag gi dri ma dag dam tshig sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga'i ril bu bsten pa dang / lam tsaṇḍa lī bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /dbang de'i mtha' rten du lung bstan pa ni/ lung bstan phal cher sprul skus ston pas/ skabs 'dir yang slob dpon gyis shākya thub pa'i nga rgyal du bsgyur nas/ de'i cha lugs dbu rag zhabs brjen la sogs pa dang / chos gos kyi grwa gnyis seṅge'i rna ba lta bur byas shing / rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pas/ khyed rnams ma 'ongs pa na rang gi gsang mtshan dang mthun pa'i de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ro zhes slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pas mgrin gcig tu lung bstan par mos pa mdzod/ 'di ltar nga yis lung bstan te/ /bcom ldan he ru ka dpal dang / /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /zhes dang / slob ma rnams la kye zhes gsang mtshan dris la/

dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ sa 'og sa steng / sa bla rnams su oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi badzra sa ma ya satwaṃ bhur bhu baḥswa/ 'di ltar ngas lung bstan pa ltar/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu lung ston par mdzad pa 'di ni sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di mthu yin no/ /dbugs dbyung ba ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /ngo bo nyid du khyod gyur to/ /khams gsum bdag por khyod gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpar khyod gyur to/ /bdud dang mu stegs thams cad las/ rgyal bar gyur pa khyod nyid do/ /grong khyer la yang grong khyer te/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i grong khyer du/ /rnal 'byor snod ldan khyod zhugs so/ /sangs rgyas grub pa'i rgyu 'di yin/ /'di la the tshom ma byed cig /ces dbugs dbyung nas/ da khyed rnams srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs pa dang bral te myur du sangs rgya bar 'gyur bas/ rang la dman pa'i blo yongs su spong la dga' ba rgya chen po bsgom par gyis shig de ltar gzengs bstod pa rnams kyi gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba song nas/ gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba zhu ba'i phyir maṇḍal 'bul ba zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum du mdzod/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /ji ltar mkhyen cing thugs chud pas/ /de ltar rjes su bdag dad na/ /de ring bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /de ltar gsol ba btab nas dbang de ma thob pa'i brdar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsung zhing mig ras rnams 'ching bar zhu/ de nas slob dpon gyi rig ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa lo bcu drug lon pa re khyed rang rnams kyi phyag rgyar yongs su gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis kyang / /shes rab 'di la brten pas 'grub/ /rigs kyi bu mchog khyod kyis kyang /

/shes rab spang du mi rung ste/ /ye shes skye ba'i gzhi yin pas/ /khyod kyi 'dod chags ma spang cig /ces gtad pa la brten nas/ rig ma des kyang / khyed rang rnams snod dang ldan mi ldan brtag pa'i phyir/ dri ba mdzad pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ bu khyod tshur shog rdo rje can/ /dri chen dri chu za nus sam/ /rakta ga pur bsten nus sam/ /bud med dang bas bsten nus sam/ /padmor 'o byed mi rtog gam/ /smros shig snod ldan ngang tshul can/ /zhes dris pa'i lan du cis kyang spro'i zhes lan btab par mos pa mdzad nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ shes rab dad pas bdag bsten to/ /dri chen la sogs bdud rtsi lnga/ /rtag tu dad pas bsten par bgyi/ /padmor bdag ni 'o bgyid do/ /zhes lan btab pa la brten nas lha mo de nyid dges te/ lus nam mkha'i gos can du byas/ chu skyes rtsa mdzes pa'i bha ga bstan nas padma'i che ba brjod pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ rmad byung nga yi padma 'di/ /bde ba thams cad 'di las rnyed/ /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kun/ /rtag tu 'di dang mi 'bral lo/ /padma 'di ni chos dbyings yin/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'di las 'byung / /sems can thams cad 'di ru grol/ /nang gi rtsa yi 'khor lo la/ /padma zhes ni rab tu brjod/ /padma'i nang gi nam mkha' zhes/ /'byung ba lnga yi rang bzhin gnas/ /lte ba dang ni ge sar bcas/ /'dab ma brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan/ /ze'u 'bru dbus nas 'byung ba yin/ /de nyid bdud rtsi dam pa yin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po'o/ /zhes brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyis rig ma'i lag pa g.yon pa/ khyed rang rnams kyi lag pa g.yas par gtad pa la brten nas rig ma'i brtul zhugs sbyin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ shes rab dam pa 'di yis ni/ /khyod kyi ye shes skyed byed pa/ /'di dang khyod nyid rtag tu yang / /dad pas rtag tu 'grogs par gyis/

/'di la rtag tu rol bar gyis/ /de ltar shes rab phyag rgya gtad pa'i dbang de bsgom lam sa dgu'i rtogs pa skyed pa'i mthu dang ldan par byas pa yin no/ /de nas nyams myong dga' ba bzhi skyed pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams he ru ka dang rig ma khro mo dbang phyug mar gsal ba'i yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i nor bur oṃ/ rtse mor phaṭa dang bcas pa/ yum gyi mkha' a las padma as mtshan pa/ yab kyi rdo rje nor bu'i rtsa bar rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i rtsa g.yas la oṃ dkar po/ rtsa g.yon la āḥdamar po/ dbus su hūm̐ mthing kha/ rtse mor phaṭa yig ser po rnams gsal lam gyis yod par mos nas/ yab yum 'khyud pa dang tsum pa dang / gsang gnas sbyar bas 'dod chags chen po'i mes drod skyes te/ thig le dngas ma rnams zhu/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i 'khor lo bzhir rim gyis brgyud de/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtsa bar byon pas dga' ba/ dbus su byon pas mchog dga'/ rtsa gsum 'joms pa'i dbus su byon pas khyad par gyi dga' ba/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor byon nas thig le dkar dmar gnyis snyoms 'jug byas pas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas pa yin snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas thig le phyir ba thag pa tsam yang ma 'dzags par rlung 'pho ba med pa'i stobs kyis hūm̐ drag la ring ba dang bcas pas yar drangs/ lte bar byon pas dga' ba/ snying khar byon pas mchog dga'/ mgrin par byon pas khyad par gyi dga' ba/ spyi bor byon pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas pa yin snyam du mos nas/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor dang / rlung la sogs pa'i sgo nas lus thams cad la khyab par dgram pas lus thams cad la rtsas khyab/ rtsa thams cad la byang chub sems kyis khyab/ de thams cad la gsal stong zung 'jug gam bde stong zung 'jug gis khyab par mos nas/ de'i ngang la cung zad tsam mnyam par 'jog pa zhu/

de dbang gi dngos gzhi yin/ dbang de thob pa'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsung zhing mig ras rnams 'grol bar zhu/ de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ gtso bor sems kyi dri ma dag dam tshig bud med la mi smod pa dang / lam pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu chos kyi sku'i bag chags dang sa bon ma lus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /de dag gis shes rab ye shes kyi dbang song nas/ dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal zhig 'bul ba zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ khyod zhabs padmo'i bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang / /gtso bos bdag la bka' drin skyobs/ /de ltar gsol ba btab nas dbang de ma thob pa'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsung zhing gdong ras rnams 'ching bar zhu/ de ltar dbang bzhi pa 'di la/ tshig gi bzhi pa/ don gyi bzhi pa/ lam du byed pa'i bzhi pa/ 'bras bu'i bzhi pa/ bzhi pa rten can rnams su yod pa las/ 'di tshig gi bzhi pa yin zhing / de yang dbang gsum pa'i dus kyi ye shes de nyid/ dbang bzhi pa'i dus tshig gi sgo nas ngo sprod pa yin te/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ /rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid/ /khyod rang yang ni de yi pha/ /de'i don ni 'di yin te/ dbang gsum pa'i dus kyi phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyar ba las byung ba'i bde stong gi ye shes 'di ni/ dpe dang gtan tshigs la sogs pas rtogs par mi nus pas ches phra/ mtshan ma dang rtog pas mi phyed pas rdo rje/ mtha' dbus dang bral bas nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu nyon mongs pa'i rdul dang bral zhing srid pa zad pa rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang sbyin par byed pas mthar sbyin/ chos sku zhi ba yang 'di las logs su btsal du med la nyams myong 'di rang rgyud la rang gis skyed par bya dgos kyi/

thabs gzhan gyi sgrub tu med pas/ 'jig rten na rigs kyi bu rang gi bskyed dgos pa bzhin yin pas/ rang gi lus lha sku snang la ma 'gags pa/ sems rgyud zag med kyi bde ba/ yul snang 'khor 'das kyi bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba/ thams cad ro gcig pa'i ngo bo la cung zad tsam mnyam par 'jog pa zhu/ dbang de thob pa'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsung zhing gdong ras rnams 'grol bar zhu/ de ltar na khyod kyis don dam pa byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa tshig tsam gyi sgo nas thob/ lus ngag yid gsum car gyi dri ma dag dam tshig dgongs te gsungs pa'i dam tshig bsrung ba dang / lam rdo rje'i rba rlabs bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i bag chags dang sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /de rnams kyi sgo nas dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par thob pas de dag gi gnas skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du bgyid snyam pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid/ /lan gsum/ dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag gi yon du maṇḍal 'bul ba zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas lus longs spyod la sogs pa thams cad kyang yon du 'bul zhing cha shas kyis kyang longs spyod du gsol snyam pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ /khyod kyis slob mar bzung ba dang / /cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /lan gsum/ de rnams kyi sgo nas dpal yang dag lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par gsan pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya che bar mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yi sogs brjod nas/ slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang / de nas dpon slob rnams kyis/ sgrub mchod zhag sbrel mar byed na tshogs 'bul ba sogs sta gon bzhin byed/

nub tha ma la/ tshogs tha ma bsgral ba'i mchod pa dang / lhag ma bstan ma skyong ba rnams 'di'i skabs su bya'o/ /gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ byin gyis brlabs nas phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ bstod pa/ dngos grub blang ba/ bzod par gsol ba rnams sta gon bzhin byas pa'i rjes la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor dang / gtor mgron gyi rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs/ med pa rnams la gshegs gsol/ bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i sogs nas/ bkra shis kyi bar sta gon bzhin rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar nas shes par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das khrag 'thung gi rgyal po dpal yang dag me dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga slob ma dga' ba skyed byed ces bya ba 'di ni/ rje btsun sa lo'i dngos kyi slob ma bgrang ba la 'das pa'i nang nas/ sa skya pa'i pha chos yang phur gyi phyogs la thugs mos pa'i yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po phyi nang gi rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas shing / rnam dag tshul khrims kyis legs par brgyan pa'i sgra tshad pa dkon mchog rgya mtsho ba dang / gung pa skyo ston dri med kyi chos brgyud 'dzin pa/ dad brtson shes rab kyi mchog dang ldan zhing gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam du ma la mkhas pa'i kun spangs mgon po rgyal mtshan pa dang / kun dga'i mtshan can de nyid kyi thugs sras dam pa/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi sogs la legs par sbyangs shing / thos bsam bsgom gsum gyi nor gyis phyug pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa mdo sngags rab 'byams pa kun dga' tshe brtan pa la sogs pas yang yang bskul ba la brten nas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po dang dbyer ma mchis shing / tshad med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ chos kyi rje sa skya paṇḍi ta chen po'i sku'i skye ba la gdon mi za ba'i rje btsun sa lo tsā ba chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang /

'dren mchog dam par gyur pa yongs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub kyi zhal snga nas dang / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rgyal sras dpal ldan bkra shis pa la sogs pa yongs 'dzin dam pa sprul pa'i sku du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len cing / chos tshul 'di la dad pa'i blo gros cung zad dang ldan pa'i snyoms las can gyi rnal 'byor ba ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis/ thams cad mkhyen pa sa lo chen po'i gsung rtsom thor bur bzhugs pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs shing / gong 'og gi chings dang mtshams sbyor mi gsal ba rnams blangs/ dam pa de dag gi gsung sgros khyad par can rnams kyis brgyan te/ zil gnon zhes bya me pho rta'i lo la/ dben pa'i ri khrod byas 'gyur rdo rje'i brag rdzong du bris pa'i yi ge pa ni blo gros mchog tu gyur pa/ ka bcu pa kun dga' seṅges bgyis so/ /dpal yang dag gi sgrub dkyil 'di dag snga mo zhig nas bsgrig pa'i blo yod kyang / cung zhig spobs pa zhan pa'i dbang du lus shing / khyad par dben gnas 'di nyid du rtsom par dam bcas tshe/ nged rang gis bsam mno zhig la rje btsun dam pa de nyid kyi gsung rtsom tshig res kyang sems can mang po la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung ba yin pas/ nged rang lta bu so so skye bo'i tshig ma gsal ba zhig gi gseb tu bsgrigs rung / phan yon mi 'byung ba'i khar nyes dmigs chen po zhig 'byung ba 'dra snyam/ blos skyungs nas rtsom pa 'phror bshol pa'i tshe/ dus mi ring ba zhig sa ga zla ba'i tshes bzhi'i nub rmi lam du/ rje btsun dam pa sa lo de nyid zhal bzhugs 'dug pa nyin sku la nye bar rab 'byams pa kun dga' tshe brtan la sogs pa dang / gzhan yang skal ldan gyi gdul bya mtha' yas pa zhig la chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor zhing gdul bya rnams smin grol la 'god bzhin pa'i ngang du bzhugs pa'i mtshams shig la/

nged rang la dges pa'i mdangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa cig mdzad kyi 'dug la mthong nas/ dad pa'i spu long cher g.yos te/ phyag dang bskor ba la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa cig byas la/ rang re'i sems steng na yod pa'i don che ba zhig yod pa de gsol ba btab pas rjes su gnang / sems bde zhing lus la bde chen gyis ye shes lta bu dga' ba dang bde ba tshad med pa skyes/ de skabs shig la/ yang dag gi gsung rtsom 'thor bu 'di rnams sngar phan bdag gis bsgrigs ma nus tshul zhib par zhus/ da ji lta bu zhig bgyid lags zhes gsol ba btab pas/ zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas nged rang gi rtsom thor bu de rnams lhan cig bsdebs shing gong 'og gi mtshams sbyor sogs khyod rang gi blo la 'dug pa bzhin bgyis pas yong ba 'dug phebs pa la brten nas/ mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa'i gdengs cung zad thob nas bris pa yin pas/ 'di la byin rlabs dang yid ches gnyis ka yod do// //dpal ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs chu bo'i rgyun/ /mi nyams gong du 'phel ba'i thabs kyi mchog /'khrul med dbang gi cho ga'i phyag len 'di/ /dam pa gsum gyis rjes bzung sa skya pa/ /ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis/ /dad pa'i spu long ches cher rab g.yos nas/ /yid kyi pad mtsho gsar pa las 'khrungs so/ /dpyod ldan kun la phan pa'i rgyun thob shog /'dir 'bad dge ba rnam dkar 'bras bu des/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas dpal chen khrag 'thung mchog /he ra ུka dang go 'phang mngon 'gyur te/ /'gro drug sangs rgyas sa la 'god par shog/ //i daṃ shā sa na ba/ sa swā hi to bha bantu// //dharme u da ya mastu// //dbang 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'/ sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ ro langs bde ba'i dngos grub/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba/ slob dpon chen po hūm̐ ka ra/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas/

paṇa chen bi ma la mi tra/ lam bu shī la mañdzu/ rna nam rdo rje 'dud 'joms/ snyags dzña na ku ma ra/ 'khon rdo rja rin chen nas rim pa bzhin brgyud la/ nye brgyud ni/ dpal he ru ka slob dpon chen po hūm̐ ka ra/ slob dponapadma 'byung gnas/ 'khon klu'i dbang po bsrung ba/ rdo rje rin chen/ shes rab yon tan/ tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ tshul khrims shes rab/ dge skyabs/ dge mthong / nyag 'bum pa shākya blo gros/ shes rab tshul khrims/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun sems dpa' chen po/ rje btsun grags pa/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ kha'u pa 'od ldan dam pa/ khu lung pa kun dga' rdo rje/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ chos sgo ba bsod nams shes rab/ yar lung pa seṅge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams dar/ dmar ston bsod nams 'od zer/ mtshungs med nam mkha' blo gros/ chag lo rin chen chos rgyal/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ sbas ba'i rnal 'byor chen po grub chen/ dpal ldan bkra shis/ yang na/ sa chen kun dga' snying po nas/ gan pa ston dar/ gan pa shes rab blo gros/ gan pa chos rgyal/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'khon ston shes rab rdo rje yan 'dra// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 52 sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ yang dag me dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 53
